mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Four sides (四) joining in harmony (合) around an enclosed central courtyard (院) form a siheyuan (四合院).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuatro alas (四) cerradas en armonía (合) abrazando un patio interior (院) definen el siheyuan (四合院).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Emblematic of ancient Chinese cosmological philosophy: square layout reflects 'round heaven and square earth' (天圆地方), fostering filial clan unity.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Three syllables: 'sì hé yuàn' (51-35-51). Descend firmly on 'sì', rise smoothly on 'hé', and drop with resonance on 'yuàn'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 四合院 specifically denotes the quadrangle courtyard residential architecture of northern China.

contrasts.analysis: 公寓 designates modern multi-story apartment complexes with elevator lobbies, whereas 四合院 is a single-story walled inward-facing courtyard.
别墅 is a standalone suburban villa surrounded by open lawns, while 四合院 encloses an internal private courtyard hidden behind high outer walls.
窑洞 refers to cave dwellings carved into Loess Plateau bluffs in northwestern China, distinct from masonry 四合院.

senses.definition_en: a traditional Chinese residential compound consisting of houses arranged around a central square courtyard on four sides
senses.definition_es: vivienda residencial tradicional china compuesta por pabellones en cuatro lados en torno a un patio central
senses.example_phrase: 北京老城区的四合院 (traditional quadrangle courtyards of old Beijing)

example_sentences.hanzi: 爷爷在北京胡同里那座青砖灰瓦的四合院里生活了大半辈子，院子里常年种着石榴树与枣树。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yéye zài Běijīng hútòng lǐ nà zuò qīngzhuān-huīwǎ de sìhéyuàn lǐ shēnghuó le dàbànbèizi, yuànzi lǐ chángnián zhòng zhe shíliushù yǔ zǎoshù.
example_sentences.en: Grandfather lived for over half his life in that grey-brick and tiled courtyard house in a Beijing alley, where pomegranate and jujube trees grew year-round.
example_sentences.es: El abuelo vivió más de media vida en aquel patio cuadrangular de ladrillo gris en un hutong pekinés, donde crecían granados y azufaifos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 作为中国传统建筑文化的杰出代表，保存完好的四合院如今已成为中外游客体验老北京民俗风情的必访之地。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zuòwéi Zhōngguó chuántǒng jiànzhù wénhuà de jiéchū dàibiǎo, bǎocún wánhǎo de sìhéyuàn rújīn yǐ chéngwéi zhōngwài yóukè tǐyàn lǎo Běijīng mínsú fēngqíng de bìfǎng zhīdì.
example_sentences.en: As an outstanding representative of traditional Chinese architectural culture, well-preserved courtyard homes are now must-visit sites for cultural immersion.
example_sentences.es: Como joya de la arquitectura tradicional china, los patios bien conservados son paradas obligadas para que viajeros de todo el mundo descubran el viejo Pekín.

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 囗 (four-sided enclosure) + 八 (diverging lines)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Enclosed box 囗 with two dividing lines inside; represents the four cardinal orientations: East, West, South, and North.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An enclosed space (囗) dividing cleanly into four cardinal quadrants (四).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un recinto cerrado (囗) dividido en cuatro cuadrantes cardinales (四).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 人 (roof / covering lid) + 一 + 口 (box container)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A lid 人 fitting seamlessly over a vessel 口; closing on all sides to form an enclosed harmonious unit.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Fitting a snug lid (人) onto a square box container (口) so four walls join seamlessly (合).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Ajustar una tapadera (人) sobre una caja (口) para que las cuatro paredes encajen en unión (合).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 阝 (earthen boundary wall) + 完 (complete / whole)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Boundary wall 阝 surrounding a completed domestic dwelling 完; a safe, open courtyard enclosed by perimeter walls.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Solid earthen perimeter walls (阝) sheltering a fully completed residential homestead (完): a peaceful courtyard (院).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Muros protectores (阝) que resguardan una vivienda entera y completa (完): el patio solariego (院).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 四合院是中国华北地区最为典型的民居建筑形式。所谓四合，‘四’指东、西、南、北四面房屋，‘合’则是四面房屋围在一起，中间形成一个宽敞的方形院落。这种建筑布局既保证了家族起居的私密，又充满了人伦温情。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Sìhéyuàn shì Zhōngguó Huáběi dìqū zuìwéi diǎnxíng de mínjū jiànzhù xíngshì. Suǒwèi sìhé, 'sì' zhǐ dōng, xī, nán, běi sì miàn fángwū, 'hé' zé shì sì miàn fángwū wéi zài yìqǐ, zhōngjiān xíngchéng yí ge kuānchǎng de fāngxíng yuànluò. Zhè zhǒng jiànzhù bùjú jì bǎozhèng le jiāzú qǐjū de sīmì, yòu chōngmǎn le rénlún wēnqíng.
extended_reading_passages.en: The siheyuan is the most typical traditional residence in North China. 'Four' refers to the houses on four sides, while 'join' means enclosing them to form a spacious central square courtyard. This layout secures domestic privacy while brimming with clan warmth.
extended_reading_passages.es: El siheyuan es la vivienda tradicional más emblemática del norte de China. Las cuatro alas en los puntos cardinales abrazan un amplio patio cuadrado central, resguardando la intimidad familiar y albergando un entrañable calor de hogar.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 大户人家的四合院通常由好几座并列组成，院落之间往往有曲折的长廊相通。院内不仅种植着玉兰与海棠，还会摆放几口大水缸饲养金鱼。关起门来，四合院就是一个自成天地的独立世界；打开院门，邻里之间推心置腹，洋溢着极其浓郁的人情味。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Dàhù rénjiā de sìhéyuàn tōngcháng yóu hǎojǐ zuò bìngliè zǔchéng, yuànluò zhījiān wǎngwǎng yǒu qūzhé de chángláng xiāngtōng. Yuànnèi bùjǐn zhòngzhí zhe yùlán yǔ hǎitáng, hái huì bǎifàng jǐ kǒu dà shuǐgāng sìyǎng jīnyú. Guān qǐ mén lái, sìhéyuàn jiùshì yí ge zìchéng-tiāndì de dúlì shìjiè; dǎkāi yuànmén, línlǐ zhījiān tuīxīn-zhìfù, yángyì zhe jíqí nóngyù de rénqíngwèi.
extended_reading_passages.en: Wealthy siheyuan compounds comprised multiple courtyards side by side linked by winding verandas. Magnolias and crabapples flourished while ceramic vats held goldfish. Closed doors created a private haven; opened doors fostered neighborly warmth.
extended_reading_passages.es: Las familias nobles alzaban varios patios yuxtapuestos enlazados por galerías. Plantaban magnolias y criaban peces de colores en tinajas. A puerta cerrada era un remanso íntimo; de par en par, emanaba una entrañable cordialidad vecinal.

meanings_summary.es: vivienda vernácula; residencia tradicional; morada popular

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The common folk (民) residing in peaceful homes (居) create vernacular folk dwellings (民居).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El pueblo llano (民) morando en sus hogares ancestrales (居) da origen a la vivienda vernácula (民居).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Contrasts with monumental imperial or religious architecture (palaces, temples), representing bottom-up domestic wisdom.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising second tone followed by level high tone: 'mín jū' (35-55). Ascend smoothly on 'mín', then sustain an even high tone on 'jū'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 民居 refers specifically to vernacular civilian houses and traditional residential architecture.

contrasts.analysis: 宫殿 refers exclusively to grand monumental imperial palaces, while 民居 belongs to common folk.
住宅 is a neutral legal term for any residential housing or modern flat, whereas 民居 implies cultural and vernacular tradition.
庙宇 designates sacred temples for worshipping gods, not everyday family residences.

senses.definition_en: traditional houses or residential vernacular dwellings built by ordinary people adapted to local climate and materials
senses.definition_es: construcción habitacional tradicional civil adaptada a los usos, clima y materiales locales
senses.example_phrase: 独具地域特色的江南民居 (Jiangnan vernacular residences with distinct regional flair)

example_sentences.hanzi: 依山傍水的皖南古民居以粉墙黛瓦和精美砖雕著称，宛如水墨画般静静坐落在青山绿水之间。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yīshān-bàngshuǐ de Wǎnnán gǔ mínjū yǐ fěnqiáng-dàiwǎ hé jīngměi zhuāndiāo zhùchēng, wǎnrú shuǐmòhuà bān jìngjìng zuòluò zài qīngshān-lǜshuǐ zhījiān.
example_sentences.en: Historic folk dwellings in southern Anhui nestled against hills and waters are famed for white walls, dark tiles, and brick carvings, resting like ink wash paintings.
example_sentences.es: Las casas tradicionales del sur de Anhui destacan por sus muros blancos, tejas oscuras y relieves primorosos, semejando una acuarela entre cerros y arroyos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 建筑历史学者深入云贵高原考察传统民居的抗震构造，旨在为现代绿色生态建筑设计汲取宝贵灵感。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jiànzhù lìshǐ xuézhě shēnrù Yún-Guì gāoyuán kǎochá chuántǒng mínjū de kàngzhèn gòuzào, zhǐzài wèi xiàndài lǜsè shēngtài jiànzhù shèjì jíqǔ bǎoguì línggǎn.
example_sentences.en: Architectural historians traveled into the Yunnan-Guizhou plateau to investigate earthquake-resilient structures in folk dwellings, gleaning insights for green architecture.
example_sentences.es: Historiadores de la arquitectura exploraron las moradas tradicionales en la meseta de Yunnan-Guizhou para incorporar técnicas sismorresistentes a la ecoarquitectura.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El cuerpo humano (尸) acomodado sobre el viejo lar solariego (古): morar en el hogar (居).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国幅员辽阔，多样的地理气候孕育了丰富多彩的传统民居样式。从陕北黄土高坡上的冬暖夏凉窑洞，到江南水乡临河筑居的吊脚楼，这些饱含民间造物智慧的传统民居，处处体现了天人合一与因地制宜的生态理念。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó fúyuán-liáokuò, duōyàng de dìlǐ qìhòu yùnyù le fēngfù-duōcǎi de chuántǒng mínjū yàngshì. Cóng Shǎnběi huángtǔ gāopō shang de dōngnuǎn-xiàliáng yáodòng, dào Jiāngnán shuǐxiāng línhé zhù jū de diàojiǎolóu, zhèxiē bǎohán mínjiān zàowù zhìhuì de chuántǒng mínjū, chùchù tǐxiàn le tiānrén-héyī yǔ yīndì-zhìyí de shēngtài lǐniàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: China's vast territory and varied climates birthed rich vernacular housing styles. From cave homes on Loess slopes to riverside stilt houses in water towns, these dwellings embody indigenous wisdom and harmony with nature.
extended_reading_passages.es: La vasta geografía china alumbró diversas tipologías de vivienda popular. Desde las cuevas bioclimáticas de Shaanxi hasta los palafitos ribereños del sur, estas moradas populares reflejan sintonía ecológica con el medio.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在华北平原广袤的大地上，四合院无疑是流传最广、最受推崇的代表性民居样式。这种建筑形式不仅与北方干燥寒冷的多风气候相契合，更凭借封闭内敛的四面房屋围合，为世代同堂的普通家族提供了遮风避雨、安居乐业的安宁天地。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài Huáběi píngyuán guǎngmào de dàdì shang, sìhéyuàn wúyí shì liúchuán zuì guǎng, zuì shòu tuīchóng de dàibiǎoxìng mínjū yàngshì. Zhè zhǒng jiànzhù xíngshì bùjǐn yǔ běifāng gānzào hánlěng de duōfēng qìhòu xiāng qìhé, gèng píngjiè fēngbì nèiliǎn de sì miàn fángwū wéihé, wèi shìdài-tóngtáng de pǔtōng jiāzú tígōng le zhēfēng-bìyǔ, ānjū-lèyè de ānníng tiāndì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Across North China's plains, the siheyuan is the most celebrated vernacular dwelling. Well-suited to the cold, windy climate, its inward-facing perimeter provided multi-generational families with shelter and tranquil harmony.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la llanura septentrional, el siheyuan es la morada vernácula cumbre. Adaptado al frío y al viento seco, su diseño recogido brindó cobijo y armonía a sucesivas generaciones bajo un mismo techo.

meanings_summary.es: combinar; asociar; integrar; combinación; conjunto

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Braiding parts together like silk strands (组) and fitting them snugly (合) forms an assembled combination (组合).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Trenzar piezas sueltas (组) y ensamblarlas con ajuste perfecto (合) da lugar a una combinación sólida (组合).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Derived from classical silk weaving and joinery carpentry where composite structures gain strength exceeding single elements.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping third tone followed by rising second tone: 'zǔ hé' (214-35). Dip low on 'zǔ' and soar smoothly on 'hé'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 组合 emphasizes assembling diverse, distinct parts into a harmonious functional set or team.

contrasts.analysis: 配合 focuses on cooperative coordination between teammates in dynamic action (配合默契), while 组合 denotes structural grouping.
集合 means rallying individuals to gather at a physical location (操场集合), whereas 组合 is configuring elements into an organized whole.
合并 involves merging two separate entities into one single legal or physical body, eliminating their distinct identities.

example_sentences.hanzi: 这套组合音响设备不仅音质清澈饱满，还支持多种无线传输协议，深受年轻音乐爱好者的青睐。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào zǔhé yīnxiǎng shèbèi bùjǐn yīnzhì qīngchè bǎomǎn, hái zhīchí duō zhǒng wúxiàn chuánshū xiéyì, shēn shòu niánqīng yīnyuè àihàozhě de qīnglài.
example_sentences.en: This modular audio system not only delivers rich sound, but supports multiple wireless protocols, earning high praise from young music buffs.
example_sentences.es: Este equipo de sonido modular no sólo ofrece fidelidad acústica, sino conectividad inalámbrica, cautivando a los jóvenes melómanos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 大型建筑师团队将传统榫卯木构件与现代高强度碳纤维巧妙组合，打造出了具有东方美学的展馆顶棚。
example_sentences.pinyin: Dàxíng jiànzhùshī tuánduì jiāng chuántǒng sǔnmǎo mù gòujiàn yǔ xiàndài gāo qiángdù tànxiānwéi qiǎomiào zǔhé, dǎzào chū le jùyǒu dōngfāng měixué de zhǎnguǎn dǐngpéng.
example_sentences.en: Architects ingeniously combined traditional mortise-and-tenon timber with modern carbon fiber, crafting an exhibition canopy brimming with Oriental aesthetics.
example_sentences.es: Los arquitectos combinaron ensambles clásicos de madera con fibra de carbono, creando una cubierta que destila elegancia oriental.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 现代企业在组建跨学科攻关团队时，非常注重不同专业背景人才的科学组合。将具有前瞻视野的战略规划师与脚踏实地的软件工程师有机组合在一起，能够碰撞出思维的灵感火花，催生出颠覆性的前沿科技成果。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xiàndài qǐyè zài zǔjiàn kuà-xuékē gōngguān tuánduì shí, fēicháng zhùzhòng bùtóng zhuānyè bèijǐng réncái de kēxué zǔhé. Jiāng jùyǒu qiánzhān shìyě de zhànlüè guīhuàshī yǔ jiǎotà-shídì de ruǎnjiàn gōngchéngshī yǒujī zǔhé zài yìqǐ, nénggòu pèngzhuàng chū sīwéi de línggǎn huǒhuā, cuīshēng chū diānfùxìng de qiányán kējì chéngguǒ.
extended_reading_passages.en: Modern enterprises building interdisciplinary teams focus on blending diverse talents. Pairing visionary strategists with pragmatic software engineers sparks creative inspiration, yielding disruptive innovations.
extended_reading_passages.es: Las empresas que crean equipos interdisciplinares buscan combinar talentos diversos. Reunir a estrategas visionarios con ingenieros prácticos detona chispas creativas, alumbrando hallazgos revolucionarios.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 四合院正是华北民居中一种精巧绝伦的组合建筑形式。正房、东西厢房以及倒座房等单体建筑并列排布，通过回廊有机组合在一起。大户人家的四合院更是由多座院落纵横并列组合而成，展现了中国传统建筑聚散有度的非凡智慧。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Sìhéyuàn zhèng shì Huáběi mínjū zhōng yì zhǒng jīngqiǎo-juélún de zǔhé jiànzhù xíngshì. Zhèngfáng, dōngxī xiāngfáng yǐjí dàozuòfáng děng dāntǐ jiànzhù bìngliè páibù, tōngguò huíláng yǒujī zǔhé zài yìqǐ. Dàhù rénjiā de sìhéyuàn gèng shì yóu duō zuò yuànluò zònghéng bìngliè zǔhé ér chéng, zhǎnxiàn le Zhōngguó chuántǒng jiànzhù jùsàn-yǒudù de fēifán zhìhuì.
extended_reading_passages.en: The siheyuan is an exquisite composite architectural form. Master rooms, side wings, and southern halls align, linked by verandas. In wealthy homes, multiple courtyards combine in series, displaying classic architectural mastery.
extended_reading_passages.es: El siheyuan es una ingeniosa estructura habitacional combinada. La sala principal, las alas laterales y estancias frontales se integran mediante galerías. En casas nobles, varios patios se yuxtaponen con sublime destreza.

meanings_summary.en: building; architecture; to construct; to erect
meanings_summary.es: edificio; arquitectura; construir; edificar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Laying out foundations (建) and ramming earth walls with bamboo poles (筑) accomplishes architecture (建筑).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Trazar los planos (建) y apisonar la tierra con pértigas de bambú (筑) define la arquitectura (建筑).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Rammed earth (夯土) and mortise-and-tenon timber form the twin pillars of historic Chinese construction culture.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two falling fourth tones: 'jiàn zhù' (51-51). Deliver two decisive downward cadences with strength.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 建筑 encompasses architectural engineering, buildings, and the physical act of construction.

contrasts.analysis: 房屋 refers concretely to residential houses or rooms for living, while 建筑 covers towers, bridges, dams, monuments, and architecture as an art.
施工 denotes the operational frontline labor process of carrying out engineering blueprints, whereas 建筑 is broader design and discipline.
大厦 refers specifically to towering multi-story commercial office towers or grand mansions.

example_sentences.hanzi: 漫步在万国建筑博览群的外滩沿岸，一幢幢巍峨耸立的欧式石砌建筑见证了上海百年的沧桑变迁。
example_sentences.pinyin: Mànbù zài wànguó jiànzhù bólǎnqún de Wàitān yán'àn, yí zhuàngzhuàng wēi'é sǒnglì de Ōushì shíqì jiànzhù jiànzhèng le Shànghǎi bǎinián de cāngsāng biànqiān.
example_sentences.en: Strolling along the Bund with its multinational architectural expo, towering European-style stone buildings bear witness to Shanghai's century of changes.
example_sentences.es: Paseando por el Bund frente a edificios de estilo europeo, las construcciones de piedra atestiguan un siglo de transformaciones en Shanghái.

example_sentences.hanzi: 现代建筑设计师越来越注重节能环保与低碳技术的应用，力争让每一座新建大楼都与城市自然生态融为一体。
example_sentences.pinyin: Xiàndài jiànzhù shèjìshī yuèláiyuè zhùzhòng jiénéng huánbǎo yǔ dītàn jìshù de yìngyòng, lìzhēng ràng měi yí zuò xīnjiàn dàlóu dōu yǔ chéngshì zìrán shēngtài róng wéi yītǐ.
example_sentences.en: Modern architects place increasing emphasis on eco-friendly efficiency and low-carbon tech, striving to harmonize every new tower with urban ecology.
example_sentences.es: Los arquitectos priorizan la eficiencia ecológica y tecnologías bajas en carbono, buscando integrar cada nuevo rascacielos en el ecosistema urbano.

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 廴 (stride forward on long road) + 聿 (hand holding writing brush / measuring compass)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Hand holding surveying stylus 聿 marching forward 廴 to lay down city foundations; establishing constitutions or buildings.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A surveyor striding forward (廴) with measuring compass (聿) to lay foundation stones for a new city (建).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un perito avanzando a paso firme (廴) con su compás (聿) para trazar los cimientos de la urbe (建).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 竹 (bamboo rammers/scaffolding) + 巩 (firm binding with craft 工 and 凡)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Bamboo radical 竹 atop 巩 (firm foundation); pounding tamped earth (夯土) walls between wooden planks with heavy rammers.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Heavy bamboo pestles (竹) pounding layers of earth firmly (巩) into rammed earth walls (筑).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Maderos y varas de bambú (竹) apisonando tierra con firmeza (巩) para alzar murallas macizas (筑).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国传统木构建筑以神奇的榫卯节点著称，通体不用一钉一铆，却能历经千年风雨侵蚀与剧烈地震考验而巍然屹立。山西应县木塔便是这一建筑奇迹的典范，完美彰显了古代华夏匠人登峰造极的结构力学智慧。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó chuántǒng mùgòu jiànzhù yǐ shénqí de sǔnmǎo jiédiǎn zhùchēng, tōngtǐ bù yòng yì dīng yì mǎo, què néng lìjīng qiānnián fēngyǔ qīnshí yǔ jùliè dìzhèn kǎoyàn ér wēirán-yìlì. Shānxī Yìngxiàn mùtǎ biàn shì zhè yí jiànzhù qíjì de diǎnfàn, wánměi zhāngxiǎn le gǔdài Huàxià jiàngrén dēngfēng-zàojí de jiégòu lìxué zhìhuì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Traditional Chinese wooden architecture is famed for ingenious mortise-and-tenon joints, enduring centuries of weathering and quakes without nails. The Yingxian Pagoda stands as an exemplar, showcasing peak structural mechanics.
extended_reading_passages.es: La arquitectura tradicional china en madera brilla por sus ensambles sin clavos, soportando terremotos durante siglos. La Pagoda de Yingxian es muestra cumbre del dominio mecánico de los maestros constructores.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 四合院不仅是华北平原最具代表性的民居建筑形式，更是一部镌刻在青砖灰瓦间的家族伦理文化史。四合院由正房、厢房和倒座房等单体建筑围合而成，严谨对称的建筑格局，深刻映照出中国传统社会长幼有序、内外有别的宗法礼乐规范。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Sìhéyuàn bùjǐn shì Huáběi píngyuán zuì jù dàibiǎoxìng de mínjū jiànzhù xíngshì, gèng shì yí bù juānkè zài qīngzhuān-huīwǎ jiān de jiāzú lúnlǐ wénhuà shǐ. Sìhéyuàn yóu zhèngfáng, xiāngfáng hé dàozuòfáng děng dāntǐ jiànzhù wéihé ér chéng, yánjǐn duìchèn de jiànzhù géjú, shēnkè yìngzhào chū Zhōngguó chuántǒng shèhuì zhǎngyòu-yǒuxù, nèiwài-yǒubié de zōngfǎ lǐyuè guīfàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: The siheyuan is not only North China's signature vernacular architecture, but a clan history engraved in bricks. Arranging master halls and wings around a courtyard, its symmetrical layout mirrors traditional patriarchal ethics.
extended_reading_passages.es: El siheyuan no es sólo la morada vernácula cumbre del norte, sino un compendio de ética familiar grabado en ladrillos. Su rigurosa simetría refleja los cánones confucianos de jerarquía y decoro doméstico.

meanings_summary.es: forma; modalidad; formato; apariencia exterior; formalidad

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Visible outward shape (形) modeled on a standard structural pattern (式) determines its form (形式).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La figura externa visible (形) ajustada a un patrón normativo (式) constituye la forma (形式).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Central philosophical polarity in Chinese literary theory: the dialectic between 'Content' (内容) and 'Form' (形式).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising second tone followed by falling fourth tone: 'xíng shì' (35-51). Lift upwards on 'xíng', then drop firmly on 'shì'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 形式 denotes the structural mode, format, or outward presentation framework.

contrasts.analysis: 内容 is the core substantive message or material inside, while 形式 is the external structural vehicle conveying it.
形状 refers strictly to geometric contour (round, square, triangular), whereas 形式 describes systemic and institutional modes.
仪式 specifically denotes ceremonial solemn rites (wedding ceremony, coronation), a specialized ritual subtype.

example_sentences.hanzi: 优秀的艺术作品应当实现思想内容与艺术形式的高度统一，切不可为了盲目追求炫目的外在技巧而牺牲作品灵魂。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yōuxiù de yìshù zuòpǐn yīngdāng shíxiàn sīxiǎng nèiróng yǔ yìshù xíngshì de gāodù tǒngyī, qiè bùkě wèile mángmù zhuīqiú xuànmù de wàizài jìqiǎo ér xīshēng zuòpǐn línghún.
example_sentences.en: Masterpieces must achieve sublime unity between ideological content and artistic form, never sacrificing soul for dazzling outward technique.
example_sentences.es: Una gran obra artística debe aunar armónicamente fondo y forma, sin sacrificar jamás el alma de la creación en pos de fuegos de artificio técnicos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 不少所谓的节日促销活动往往只是流于形式，商家口头承诺的优惠打折并不能真正让普通消费者获得实惠。
example_sentences.pinyin: Bùshǎo suǒwèi de jiérì cùxiāo huódòng wǎngwǎng zhǐshì liú yú xíngshì, shāngjiā kǒutóu chéngnuò de yōuhuì dǎzhé bìng bùnéng zhēnzhèng ràng pǔtōng xiāofèizhě huòdé shíhuì.
example_sentences.en: Many so-called holiday promotions are mere formalities; verbal discounts promised by merchants rarely provide genuine benefits to consumers.
example_sentences.es: Muchas rebajas festivas se quedan en mera formalidad; los descuentos prometidos por los comerciantes rara vez aportan un ahorro real.

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 开 / 井 (framing lattice) + 彡 (strokes of beauty / contour)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A framing lattice 开 decorated with hair strokes 彡; visible contours, bodily shapes, and outward silhouettes.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Drawing contour brushstrokes (彡) over a framing grid to outline an elegant physical form (形).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Trazar pinceladas de contorno (彡) sobre una cuadrícula para plasmar una figura visible (形).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Carpenter's square 工 affixed to an arrow stake 弋; an officially approved template, formula, or ceremonial standard.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A carpenter aligning his tool (工) against an upright reference post (弋) to set a standard pattern (式).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El artesano calibrando su escuadra (工) con una estaca patrón (弋) para fijar el modelo normativo (式).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代艺术创作中，艺术家们不断探索突破传统媒介形式的崭新可能。从架上绘画延伸到沉浸式数字光影互动，艺术的表现形式虽然历经沧桑巨变，但其核心所承载的人文关怀与对真善美的永恒追寻，却始终历久弥新。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài yìshù chuàngzuò zhōng, yìshùjiāmen búduàn tànsuǒ tūpò chuántǒng méijiè xíngshì de zhǎnxīn kěnéng. Cóng jiàshàng huìhuà yánshēn dào chénjìnsì shùzì guāngyǐng hùdòng, yìshù de biǎoxiàn xíngshì suīrán lìjīng cāngsāng jùbiàn, dàn qí héxīn suǒ chéngzài de rénwén guānhuái yǔ duì zhēn-shàn-měi de yǒnghéng zhuīxún, què shǐzhōng lìjiǔ-míxīn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In contemporary art, creators constantly explore new possibilities breaking classical formats. From canvas paintings to digital light projections, while artistic forms transform, the pursuit of truth, goodness, and beauty remains eternal.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el arte actual, los creadores trascienden formatos clásicos. Del lienzo a las instalaciones lumínicas digitales, aunque la forma de expresión mute, el anhelo humanista de verdad y belleza pervive intacto.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 四合院是中国传统民居建筑中最具生命力的经典组合形式。四合院由正房、倒座房及东西厢房在四面围合而成，这种形式既有效阻挡了北方的早春风沙与冬季严寒，又在院落中央为家人留出了栽花种草、享受天伦之乐的露天生活空间。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Sìhéyuàn shì Zhōngguó chuántǒng mínjū jiànzhù zhōng zuì jù shēngmìnglì de jīngdiǎn zǔhé xíngshì. Sìhéyuàn yóu zhèngfáng, dàozuòfáng jí dōngxī xiāngfáng zài sì miàn wéihé ér chéng, zhè zhǒng xíngshì jì yǒuxiào zǔdǎng le běifāng de zǎochūn fēngshā yǔ dōngjì yánhán, yòu zài yuànluò zhōngyāng wèi jiārén liú chū le zāihuā-zhòngcǎo, xiǎngshòu tiānlúnzhīlè de lùtiān shēnghuó kōngjiān.
extended_reading_passages.en: The siheyuan is the most vital composite form in traditional Chinese housing. Enclosed on four sides by halls and wings, this format blocks cold desert winds while securing a private open garden courtyard for clan communion.
extended_reading_passages.es: El siheyuan es la forma arquitectónica combinada más señera de China. Rodeado por cuatro alas, este modelo aísla de ventiscas y polvo, reservando un patio al aire libre para disfrutar de la dicha familiar.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: What (所) is stated and named by spoken words (谓) defines the so-called term (所谓).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Aquello (所) que se enuncia y denomina con palabras (谓) es lo que se llama (所谓).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Essential classical expository marker (所谓的 'what is termed...') used in academic definition and dialectical skepticism.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping third tone followed by falling fourth tone: 'suǒ wèi' (214-51). Dip low on 'suǒ', then descend decisively on 'wèi'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 所谓 introduces an explicit definition of a concept or expresses ironic skepticism toward a label.

contrasts.analysis: 名义 is a noun meaning titular capacity or pretext (以朋友的名义), while 所谓 is a modifier explaining definitions or questioning authenticity.
据说 introduces reported hearsay from outside sources (据说要下雨), while 所谓 defines terminology or questions validity.
称作 is a transitive predicate verb meaning 'to be called' (这种鸟被称作翠鸟), while 所谓 is an attributive modifier.

senses.definition_es: lo que comúnmente se denomina o entiende por tal concepto
senses.example_phrase: 所谓四合，即四面房屋围在一起 (the so-called 'four-join' means houses on four sides)

senses.definition_en: so-called (used skeptically or disapprovingly to denote false claims)

senses.example_phrase: 别相信那些所谓专家的养生秘诀 (don't trust those so-called experts' secrets)

example_sentences.hanzi: 所谓四合院，‘四’指东、西、南、北四面，‘合’则是四面房屋围在一起，形成封闭的方形院落。
example_sentences.pinyin: Suǒwèi sìhéyuàn, 'sì' zhǐ dōng, xī, nán, běi sì miàn, 'hé' zé shì sì miàn fángwū wéi zài yìqǐ, xíngchéng fēngbì de fāngxíng yuànluò.
example_sentences.en: As for the so-called siheyuan, 'four' signifies the four directions, while 'join' means enclosing houses on four sides into a private square courtyard.
example_sentences.es: En el llamado siheyuan, 'cuatro' alude a los cuatro puntos cardinales y 'juntar' describe cuatro pabellones abrazando un patio cuadrado íntimo.

example_sentences.hanzi: 消费者应当保持理性清醒，切勿轻信网络上那些未经权威科学认证的所谓‘抗衰老神药’。
example_sentences.pinyin: Xiāofèizhě yīngdāng bǎochí lǐxìng qīngxǐng, qièwù qīngxìn wǎngluò shang nàxiē wèijīng quánwēi kēxué rènzhèng de suǒwèi 'kàng shuāilǎo shényào'.
example_sentences.en: Consumers should stay rational and avoid falling for uncertified 'anti-aging miracles' touted by so-called medical gurus online.
example_sentences.es: Los consumidores deben mantener la cautela y desconfiar de los supuestos 'remedios milagrosos antiedad' que proliferan en internet sin aval científico.

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 户 (single door) + 斤 (axe chopping timber on doorstep)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: An axe 斤 chopping wood at a homestead door 户; originally the designated chopping spot, developing into places and passive pronoun particle.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Setting down an axe (斤) at the wooden threshold (户) to mark an established dwelling place (所).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Apoyar el hacha (斤) en el umbral de la puerta (户) para señalar el lugar de asiento (所).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 讠 (spoken words) + 胃 (stomach / inner intent)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Speech radical 讠 beside stomach 胃; voicing words that express what is harbored in one's stomach/mind.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Uttering spoken words (讠) straight from the gut (胃) to name and define a truth (谓).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Pronunciar palabras claras (讠) que brotan de las entrañas (胃) para nombrar las cosas (谓).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 探寻传统建筑之美，必须先理解其造字立意的文化源头。所谓四合，‘四’指东、西、南、北四面房屋，‘合’则是四面房屋围合在一起。这简简单单的两个汉字，生动凝练地勾勒出了北方民居中正平和的审美意境。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Tànxún chuántǒng jiànzhù zhī měi, bìxū xiān lǐjiě qí zàozì lìyì de wénhuà yuántóu. Suǒwèi sìhé, 'sì' zhǐ dōng, xī, nán, běi sì miàn fángwū, 'hé' zé shì sì miàn fángwū wéihé zài yìqǐ. Zhè jiǎnjiǎn-dāndān de liǎng ge Hànzì, shēngdòng níngliàn de gōulè chū le běifāng mínjū zhōngzhèng-pínghé de shěnměi yìjìng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Exploring the beauty of architecture requires understanding cultural etymology. The 'four-join' implies buildings on four sides enclosing a yard. These two characters sketch the harmonious aesthetic core of northern vernacular homes.
extended_reading_passages.es: Para apreciar la arquitectura tradicional conviene desentrañar sus raíces léxicas. Lo de 'cuatro juntas' define pabellones en los cuatro rumbos cerrándose en torno al patio, compendiando la serena armonía solariega.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在快节奏的商业炒作中，不少打着所谓‘传统古建’旗号的新建仿古街区，由于过度追求商业利益而丧失了原汁原味的民俗烟火气。真正值得我们倍加珍视的，从来不是冰冷的水泥仿品，而是老北京四合院里世代相传的质朴温情。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài kuài jiézòu de shāngyè chǎozuò zhōng, bùshǎo dǎ zhe suǒwèi 'chuántǒng gǔjiàn' qíhào de xīnjiàn fǎnggǔ jiēqū, yóuyú guòdù zhuīqiú shāngyè lìyì ér sàngshī le yuánzhī-yuánwèi de mínsú yānhuǒqì. Zhēnzhèng zhíde wǒmen bèijiā zhēnshì de, cónglái búshì bīnglěng de shuǐní fǎngpǐn, érshì lǎo Běijīng sìhéyuàn lǐ shìdài-xiāngchuán de zhípǔ wēnqíng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Amid commercial hype, many new pedestrian streets under so-called 'heritage' banners forfeit authentic community life in greed. What deserves cherishing is never cold concrete facsimiles, but the timeless warmth preserved in old courtyards.
extended_reading_passages.es: Entre el bullicio mercantil, muchos recintos que se anuncian como 'patrimonio histórico' pierden su autenticidad por el lucro. Lo que de veras vale la pena rescatar es el calor humano vivo de los patios tradicionales.

meanings_summary.es: cuadrado; recto; probo; dirección; bando

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Twin boats lashed straight (方) form four right angles and determine spatial cardinal directions (方).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Dos barcazas amarradas en ángulo recto (方) evocan la rectitud del cuadrado y los rumbos (方).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Foundational in Chinese cosmology ('天圆地方' round sky, square earth); geometry of city planning from Chang'an to Beijing.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Level high tone: 'fāng' (55). Hold an even, clear high pitch without wavering.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 方 describes right-angled, square geometric structure as well as moral uprightness.

contrasts.analysis: 方 denotes four-sided right-angled rigidity, while 圆 represents fluid, curved circularity without corners.
直 means one-dimensional straightness without bends, while 方 describes a two-dimensional square shape.
平 denotes flat, level surface elevation without bumps, whereas 方 refers to planar polygon geometry.

example_sentences.hanzi: 中国古代四合院的四面房屋围合在一起，正好在中央形成一个规整方正的庭院空间。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài sìhéyuàn de sì miàn fángwū wéihé zài yìqǐ, zhènghǎo zài zhōngyāng xíngchéng yí ge guīzhěng fāngzhèng de tíngyuàn kōngjiān.
example_sentences.en: The houses on four sides of a traditional siheyuan enclose each other, forming a neatly square courtyard space right in the center.
example_sentences.es: Los pabellones a cuatro vientos del siheyuan tradicional confluyen delimitando en el centro un patio cuadrangular de gran armonía.

example_sentences.hanzi: 做人应当有方有圆，既要恪守内心的原则底线，又要懂得在处世待人时保持柔和宽容。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zuòrén yīngdāng yǒufāng-yǒuyuán, jì yào kèshǒu nèixīn de yuánzé dǐxiàn, yòu yào dǒngde zài chǔshì dàirén shí bǎochí róuhé kuānróng.
example_sentences.en: In conducting oneself, one should blend square principles with circular adaptability—holding ethical baselines while remaining gentle toward others.
example_sentences.es: En la vida conviene aunar firmeza y flexibilidad: ser fiel a los principios morales inquebrantables, pero afable y comprensivo en el trato social.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictograph of two twin boats tied parallel to cross rivers; evolved into straight edges, squares, and spatial directions.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Twin wooden boats lashed parallel with straight squared sides (方) to cross the waterway smoothly.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dos barcas de madera acopladas en paralelo con cantos rectos (方) para cruzar el río.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国古代铜钱外圆内方，将‘天圆地方’的哲学宇宙观巧妙地熔铸于方寸金属之间。古人借这枚小小的钱币告诫后世子孙：处世当外圆内方，对外应圆融通达、谦和宽厚，对内则当心如明镜、秉持正道，坚守立身原则。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài tóngqián wàiyuán-nèifāng, jiāng 'tiānyuán-dìfāng' de zhéxué yǔzhòuguān qiǎomiào de róngzhù yú fāngcùn jīnshǔ zhījiān. Gǔrén jiè zhè méi xiǎoxiǎo de qiánbì gàojiè hòushì zǐsūn: chǔshì dāng wàiyuán-nèifāng, duìwài yīng yuánróng-tōngdá, qiānhé kuānhòu, duìnèi zé dāng xīnrú-míngjìng, bǐngchí zhèngdào, jiānshǒu lìshēn yuánzé.
extended_reading_passages.en: Ancient coins had a round exterior with a square hole, embodying 'round heaven, square earth'. Sages used this design to instruct descendants: be adaptable like a circle outwardly, but unyielding and upright like a square within.
extended_reading_passages.es: Las monedas clásicas chinas eran redondas con orificio cuadrado, plasmando el cosmos. Enseñaban a ser circulares por fuera en afabilidad, pero cuadrados por dentro en rectitud y fidelidad a los principios.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 所谓四合院，正是由东、西、南、北四面房屋围合在一起，在正中央形成一个规整方正的庭院。这种方方正正的四合院格局，不仅反映了华夏先民对秩序对称与中正之美的追求，更营造出一种安定沉稳、聚气凝神的绝佳居住环境。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suǒwèi sìhéyuàn, zhèng shì yóu dōng, xī, nán, běi sì miàn fángwū wéihé zài yìqǐ, zài zhèng zhōngyāng xíngchéng yí ge guīzhěng fāngzhèng de tíngyuàn. Zhè zhǒng fāngfang-zhèngzhèng de sìhéyuàn géjú, bùjǐn fǎnyìng le Huàxià xiānmín duì zhìxù duìchèn yǔ zhōngzhèng zhī měi de zhuīqiú, gèng yíngzào chū yì zhǒng āndìng chénwěn, jùqì-níngshén de juéjiā jūzhù huánjìng.
extended_reading_passages.en: The siheyuan is formed by houses on four sides enclosing a neat square courtyard in the center. This squared layout reflects ancient desires for symmetry and balance, creating an oasis of stability that gathers positive vitality.
extended_reading_passages.es: El siheyuan abraza un patio cuadrado en su corazón gracias a sus cuatro pabellones. Esa pulcra traza cuadrangular refleja el amor por la simetría y el orden, forjando un remanso apacible para la vida en familia.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A spacious hall's breadth (广) combined with overflowing water diffusing across plains (泛) is widespread (广泛).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La vasta amplitud del monte (广) unida al agua que se desborda por el llano (泛) denota lo extenso (广泛).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Combines spatial breadth (广) with hydrological diffusion (泛) to signify extensive coverage across society and geography.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping third tone followed by falling fourth tone: 'guǎng fàn' (214-51). Dip low on 'guǎng' and strike firmly down on 'fàn'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 广泛 denotes extensive geographic distribution, large participant scale, or multi-disciplinary coverage.

contrasts.analysis: 普遍 means common or typical across most cases (普遍现象), while 广泛 highlights wide scope and breadth of reach (广泛涉猎).
宽阔 refers strictly to concrete physical dimensions of spaces or rivers (宽阔的马路), whereas 广泛 applies to abstract domains.
全面 emphasizes thoroughness without missing angles (全面分析), while 广泛 emphasizes far-flung reach.

example_sentences.hanzi: 随着新能源汽车技术的日益成熟，这种绿色低碳的出行方式正在全国各大城市得到广泛普及。
example_sentences.pinyin: Suízhe xīnnéngyuán qìchē jìshù de rìyì chéngshú, zhè zhǒng lǜsè dītàn de chūxíng fāngshì zhèng zài quánguó gèdà chéngshì dédào guǎngfàn pǔjí.
example_sentences.en: With new energy vehicle technologies maturing, this green and low-carbon travel mode is gaining widespread adoption across major cities.
example_sentences.es: Con el avance del coche eléctrico, este medio de transporte limpio se difunde de forma generalizada en las principales metrópolis del país.

example_sentences.hanzi: 这位博学多才的大学教授不仅精通古代文献考据，还广泛涉猎天文学、心理学以及认知神经科学。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi bóxué-duōcái de dàxué jiàoshòu bùjǐn jīngtōng gǔdài wénxiàn kǎojù, hái guǎngfàn shèliè tiānwénxué, xīnlǐxué yǐjí rènzhī shénjīng kēxué.
example_sentences.en: This erudite professor is not only versed in classical philology, but reads broadly across astronomy, psychology, and cognitive neuroscience.
example_sentences.es: Este sabio catedrático no sólo domina la filología clásica, sino que estudia con amplitud la astronomía, la psicología y la neurociencia cognitiva.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国传统草本医药在数千年的防病治病实践中积累了丰富经验，其安全有效的治疗理念在世界各地赢得了日益广泛的国际认可。越来越多的海外科研机构建立合作中心，对中医药的天然活性分子展开深入系统研究。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó chuántǒng cǎoběn yīyào zài shùqiān nián de fángbìng-zhìbìng shíjiàn zhōng jīlěi le fēngfù jīngyàn, qí ānquán yǒuxiào de zhìliáo lǐniàn zài shìjiè gèdì yíngdé le rìyì guǎngfàn de guójì rènkě. Yuèláiyuè duō de hǎiwài kēyán jīgòu jiànlì hézuò zhōngxīn, duì zhōngyīyào de tiānrán huóxìng fēnzǐ zhǎnkāi shēnrù xìtǒng yánjiū.
extended_reading_passages.en: Traditional Chinese herbal medicine accumulated clinical experience over millennia, winning widespread international acclaim for its safety. Global research centers increasingly partner to analyze natural active molecules.
extended_reading_passages.es: La medicina herbaria tradicional china goza de un creciente reconocimiento internacional gracias a su eficacia milenaria. Prestigiosos centros extranjeros investigan sus compuestos activos en proyectos conjuntos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 四合院不仅在北京老城落地生根，作为中国北方传统民居的重要代表，它在河北、山东以及山西等广大北方省份都有着极其广泛的分布。不论是市井平民的简朴小院，还是王府巨贾的深宅大院，四合院的样式都展现出了跨越阶层的强大文化凝聚力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Sìhéyuàn bùjǐn zài Běijīng lǎochéng luòdì-shēnggēn, zuòwéi Zhōngguó běifāng chuántǒng mínjū de zhòngyào dàibiǎo, tā zài Héběi, Shāndōng yǐjí Shānxī děng guǎngdà běifāng shěngfèn dōu yǒuzhe jíqí guǎngfàn de fēnbù. Búlùn shì shìjǐng píngmín de jiǎnpǔ xiǎoyuàn, háishì wángfǔ jùjiǎ de shēnzhái-dàyuàn, sìhéyuàn de yàngshì dōu zhǎnxiàn chū le kuàyuè jiēcéng de qiángdà wénhuà níngjùlì.
extended_reading_passages.en: The siheyuan not only rooted in Beijing, but was widely distributed across Hebei, Shandong, and Shanxi. From humble alley courtyards to aristocratic mansions, the siheyuan showcased unifying cultural cohesion across classes.
extended_reading_passages.es: El siheyuan floreció en Pekín y se extendió con amplitud por Hebei, Shandong y Shanxi. De las modestas casas del pueblo a los palacetes nobiliarios, este modelo derrochó una admirable cohesión cultural.

meanings_summary.es: estilo; modelo; diseño; hechura; corte

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A carved wooden prototype (样) combined with an approved standard rule (式) defines a tangible style (样式).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un molde de madera tallado (样) sumado al patrón normativo (式) compone el estilo o hechura (样式).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Historic title of imperial architectural draftsmen in Beijing: '样式雷' (Style Lei family), master architects of the Forbidden City and Summer Palace.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two falling fourth tones: 'yàng shì' (51-51). Strike both syllables with decisive, balanced downward cadence.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 样式 refers to the visual design, cut, or aesthetic configuration of physical manufactured goods or structures.

contrasts.analysis: 模式 refers to abstract business, operational, or economic paradigms (商业模式), while 样式 denotes tangible physical shape and cut.
款式 is commonly used for commercial fashion apparel and consumer gadgets (最新款式), while 样式 encompasses architecture and traditional crafts.
形式 is philosophical/abstract (form vs content), while 样式 is concrete visual aesthetics.

example_sentences.hanzi: 这款新上市的运动鞋在外观样式上巧妙融入了中国传统山水纹样，一经推出便赢得了年轻消费者的热烈追捧。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xīn shàngshì de yùndòngxié zài wàiguān yàngshì shang qiǎomiào róngrù le Zhōngguó chuántǒng shānshuǐ wényàng, yījīng tuīchū biàn yíngdé le niánqīng xiāofèizhě de rèliè zhuīpěng.
example_sentences.en: This newly released sneaker seamlessly blends traditional Chinese landscape patterns into its design style, instantly captivating young consumers.
example_sentences.es: Esta nueva zapatilla incorpora motivos de pintura paisajística tradicional en su diseño exterior, cautivando al público juvenil desde su lanzamiento.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在老城区建筑立面改造过程中，工程师们严格参照历史档案，力求精准还原民国时期的门窗样式。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài lǎochéngqū jiànzhù lìmiàn gǎizào guòchéng zhōng, gōngchéngshīmen yángé cānzhào lìshǐ dàng'àn, lìqiú jīngzhǔn huányuán Mínguó shíqí de ménchuāng yàngshì.
example_sentences.en: During facade restorations in the old quarters, engineers consulted historic archives to faithfully restore Republican-era window and door styles.
example_sentences.es: En la rehabilitación de fachadas del casco viejo, los peritos consultaron archivos históricos para recrear fielmente la hechura de puertas y cancelas de época.

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 木 (wooden casting mold) + 羊 (sheep / auspicious horn shape)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Tree radical 木 beside 羊; originally a wooden casting mold carved with decorative patterns to shape prototypes and samples.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Carving fine wooden molds (木) shaped like graceful ram horns (羊) to forge beautiful samples (样).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Tallar moldes de madera (木) con la fina curva de cuernos de carnero (羊) para crear modelos (样).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 弋 (reference stake marker) + 工 (carpenter's square)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A carpenter's tool 工 aligned against a stake 弋; an officially approved standard prototype, rule, or model.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Calibrating a craftsman's square (工) against an upright post (弋) to define standard style (式).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Alinear la escuadra artesanal (工) frente al poste patrón (弋) para dictar el estilo normativo (式).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在故宫与颐和园的营造史中，清代内务府‘样式房’执掌了所有皇家宫殿的设计大权。其中声名赫赫的‘样式雷’世家历经八代传承，绘制了成千上万件烫样与精美图纸，将中国古建筑样式的美感推向了举世瞩目的艺术巅峰。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài Gùgōng yǔ Yíhéyuán de yíngzào shǐ zhōng, Qīngdài Nèiwùfǔ 'Yàngshì Fáng' zhízhǎng le suǒyǒu huángjiā gōngdiàn de shèjì dàquán. Qízhōng shēngmíng-hèhè de 'Yàngshì Léi' shìjiā lìjīng bā dài chuánchéng, huìzhì le chéngqiān-shàngwàn jiàn tàngyàng yǔ jīngměi túzhǐ, jiāng Zhōngguó gǔ jiànzhù yàngshì de měigǎn tuīxiàng le jǔshì-zhǔmù de yìshù diānfēng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In Forbidden City and Summer Palace history, the Qing Imperial Workshop's 'Style Chamber' oversaw designs. The famed 'Style Lei' family across eight generations produced thousands of architectural models, elevating palace styles to global peaks.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la corte Qing, la 'Cámara de Estilo' diseñó la Ciudad Prohibida. La célebre dinastía 'Estilo Lei' forjó maquetas y planos primorosos durante ocho generaciones, elevando la arquitectura palaciega a su cúspide.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 四合院是北方传统民居最经典的典型样式。这种建筑样式分布广泛，虽然在各地因地制宜产生过细微的构造演化，但四面合围、尊卑有别以及中轴对称的核心格局始终未曾改变，成为千百年来北方人安放乡愁的温馨依托。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Sìhéyuàn shì běifāng chuántǒng mínjū zuì jīngdiǎn de diǎnxíng yàngshì. Zhè zhǒng jiànzhù yàngshì fēnbù guǎngfàn, suīrán zài gèdì yīndì-zhìyí chǎnshēng guò xìwēi de gòuzào yǎnhuà, dàn sì miàn héwéi, zūnbēi-yǒubié yǐjí zhōngzhóu duìchèn de héxīn géjú shǐzhōng wèicéng gǎibiàn, chéngwéi qiānbǎinián lái běifāngrén ānfàng xiāngchóu de wēnxīn yītuō.
extended_reading_passages.en: The siheyuan is the signature archetype of northern vernacular dwellings. Widely distributed, while adapting locally with subtle structural tweaks, its central axis symmetry and enclosed yard remained unchanged, cradling nostalgic warmth.
extended_reading_passages.es: El siheyuan es el modelo arquetípico de la vivienda popular norteña. Con sutiles adaptaciones locales, su patio cerrado y rigurosa simetría se mantuvieron inmutables, acogiendo el apego solariego de generaciones.

meanings_summary.en: representative; delegate; to represent; stand for
meanings_summary.es: representante; delegado; representar; simbolizar; ejemplar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Standing as a personal proxy (代) to manifest outward representation (表) makes one a delegate (代表).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Actuar como portavoz suplente (代) para manifestar externamente una voz (表) es representar (代表).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Blends proxy delegation (代) with manifestation (表), central to governance and canonical typology.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling fourth tone followed by dipping third tone: 'dài biǎo' (51-214). Drop firmly on 'dài', then dip low and scoop upward on 'biǎo'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 代表 indicates authorized proxy status or serving as the definitive exemplar of an entire category.

contrasts.analysis: 象征 refers to symbolic metaphors or artistic emblems (鸽子象征和平), while 代表 denotes authoritative proxy delegation or exemplary prototypes.
代理 focuses strictly on commercial or legal agency powers (代理人, 代理品牌), whereas 代表 carries broader cultural embodiment.
典型 is primarily an adjective meaning quintessential or representative (典型案例), while 代表 can function actively as a verb.

example_sentences.hanzi: 作为青年科研人员代表，他在全国科技创新表彰大会上作了激情澎湃的汇报发言。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zuòwéi qīngnián kēyán rényuán dàibiǎo, tā zài quánguó kējì chuàngxīn biǎozhāng dàhuì shang zuò le jīqíng-péngpài de huìbào fāyán.
example_sentences.en: As a representative of young scientific researchers, he delivered an impassioned keynote speech at the National Science and Technology Innovation Conference.
example_sentences.es: Como portavoz de los jóvenes investigadores, pronunció un vibrante discurso en el Congreso Nacional de Innovación Tecnológica.

example_sentences.hanzi: 红墙黄瓦的故宫不仅是古代皇权建筑的顶峰，更代表了中华民族源远流长的营造智慧与审美追求。
example_sentences.pinyin: Hóngqiáng-huángwǎ de Gùgōng bùjǐn shì gǔdài huángquán jiànzhù de dǐngfēng, gèng dàibiǎo le Zhōnghuá mínzú yuányuǎn-liúcháng de yíngzào zhìhuì yǔ shěnměi zhuīqiú.
example_sentences.en: The Forbidden City with red walls and yellow glazed tiles is not only the pinnacle of imperial architecture, but represents China's enduring craftsmanship and aesthetic pursuit.
example_sentences.es: La Ciudad Prohibida no sólo encarna la cúspide palaciega, sino que representa la milenaria sabiduría constructiva y el ideal estético chino.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A person 亻 standing beside a boundary stake 弋 to relieve or substitute a sentry; replacing, acting as proxy, or generation.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A relief guard (亻) taking his station by the watchtower post (弋) to act as proxy (代).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un relevo de guardia (亻) que ocupa su puesto junto al poste vigía (弋) en sustitución (代).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Garment radical 衣 displaying outer fur on its surface; the visible exterior manifested outward for all to witness.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Wearing a warm fur robe (衣) with lustrous fleece visible outside, expressing outer dignity (表).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Lucir una túnica (衣) cuyo forro viste por fuera mostrando apostura visible (表).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国优秀文学经典作品往往以深刻的人物命运折射出整个时代的精神风貌。鲁迅先生笔下的阿Q形象，作为旧中国国民劣根性与精神胜利法的艺术代表，以极其辛辣深刻的讽刺笔触，唤醒了无数沉睡麻木的心灵。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó yōuxiù wénxué jīngdiǎn zuòpǐn wǎngwǎng yǐ shēnkè de rénwù mìngyùn zhéshè chū zhěnggè shídài de jīngshén fēngmào. Lǔ Xùn xiānsheng bǐxià de Ā Q xíngxiàng, zuòwéi jiù Zhōngguó guómín liègènxìng yǔ jīngshén-shènglìfǎ de yìshù dàibiǎo, yǐ jíqí xīnlà shēnkè de fěngcì bǐchù, huànxǐng le wúshù chénsùi māmù de xīnlíng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Chinese literary masterpieces mirror eras through profound character destinies. Lu Xun's Ah Q, as the artistic embodiment of psychological victory and complacency, awakened numb souls with biting, piercing satire.
extended_reading_passages.es: Las obras maestras chinas retratan épocas mediante destinos memorables. El célebre Ah Q de Lu Xun, como símbolo artístico del autoengaño resignado, sacudió conciencias con una sátira lúcida e implacable.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 四合院不仅是历史悠久的传统民居，更是北方建筑文化当之无愧的重要代表。四面房屋形成的封闭空间，不仅体现了长幼有序的儒家家族伦理，更生动代表了中国人向内凝聚、安居守正的居住哲学，在岁月变迁中绽放着不朽的文明光彩。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Sìhéyuàn bùjǐn shì lìshǐ-yōujiǔ de chuántǒng mínjū, gèng shì běifāng jiànzhù wénhuà dāngzhī-wúkuì de zhòngyào dàibiǎo. Sì miàn fángwū xíngchéng de fēngbì kōngjiān, bùjǐn tǐxiàn le zhǎngyòu-yǒuxù de Rújiā jiāzú lúnlǐ, gèng shēngdòng dàibiǎo le Zhōngguórén xiàngnèi níngjù, ānjū-shǒuzhèng de jūzhù zhéxué, zài suìyuè biànqiān zhōng zhànfàng zhe bùxiǔ de wénmíng guāngcǎi.
extended_reading_passages.en: The siheyuan is not only an ancient folk house, but an undisputed representative of northern architectural culture. Its enclosed space embodies Confucian family ethics and reflective residential philosophy, radiating timeless brilliance.
extended_reading_passages.es: El siheyuan es la máxima encarnación de la cultura constructiva septentrional. Su recinto cerrado simboliza la armonía confuciana y la filosofía del recogimiento sereno, brillando como un legado inmortal.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Moving openly through (通) enduring daily customs (常) reflects what usually (通常) happens.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Transitar abiertamente (通) por costumbres constantes (常) define lo que ocurre habitualmente (通常).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Blends 'thoroughfare connectivity' (通) with 'temporal constancy' (常) to signify everyday default patterns.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: First tone to second tone: 'tōng cháng' (55-35). Start on a level high pitch and rise steadily.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 通常 expresses standard, prevailing probability under general everyday conditions.

contrasts.analysis: 经常 focuses on high temporal frequency (often/repeatedly), whereas 通常 denotes standard regular practice or probability.
平常 functions as an adjective meaning ordinary or unexceptional, while 通常 acts adverbially for prevailing customs.
一向 denotes unbroken persistence from the past up to now ('all along'), whereas 通常 expresses the customary norm.

senses.definition_es: en condiciones habituales o normales; por regla general

example_sentences.hanzi: 在老北京四合院中，北面的正房通常留给家中辈分最高的老人居住，以示敬重。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài lǎo Běijīng sìhéyuàn zhōng, běimiàn de zhèngfáng tōngcháng liú gěi jiāzhōng bèifèn zuìgāo de lǎorén jūzhù, yǐ shì jìngzhòng.
example_sentences.en: In old Beijing courtyards, the north main room is usually reserved for the family's senior elders as a mark of respect.
example_sentences.es: En los patios tradicionales de Pekín, la sala principal del norte suele reservarse a los ancianos de mayor jerarquía familiar en señal de respeto.

example_sentences.hanzi: 若没有突发状况，国际客运航班通常会按照既定时刻表准点起飞与降落。
example_sentences.pinyin: Ruò méiyǒu tūfā zhuàngkuàng, guójì kèyùn hángbān tōngcháng huì ànzhào jìdìng shíkèbiǎo zhǔndiǎn qǐfēi yǔ jiàngluò.
example_sentences.en: Barring unexpected emergencies, international passenger flights usually take off and land punctually per the schedule.
example_sentences.es: Salvo imprevistos de última hora, los vuelos comerciales internacionales suelen despegar y aterrizar con puntualidad según el horario fijado.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Motion 辶 moving unobstructed along a paved thoroughfare 甬; implies uninterrupted flow and broad currency.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Moving smoothly along an open road (辶) with nothing blocking the passage (通).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Avanzar con fluidez por un camino expedito (辶) sin obstáculos que cierren el paso (通).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A standard skirt or banner 巾 hung prominently; represents constancy, enduring routines, and norms.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A distinctive banner (巾) hung permanently aloft that serves as an enduring everyday standard (常).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un estandarte ceremonial (巾) suspendido de modo permanente como norma constante de la vida diaria (常).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在老北京的合院建筑规制中，建筑用料通常由房主的社会身份决定。王府公馆通常使用考究的青白石台基与琉璃瓦件，而普通平民住宅则通常采用素雅质朴的灰色砖瓦。这种习惯体现了古代严密的礼制等级。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài lǎo Běijīng de héyuàn jiànzhù guīzhì zhōng, jiànzhù yòngliào tōngcháng yóu fángzhǔ de shèhuì shēnfèn juédìng. Wángfǔ gōngguǎn tōngcháng shǐyòng kǎojiu de qīngbáishí táijī yǔ liúliwǎ jiàn, ér pǔtōng píngmín zhùzhái zé tōngcháng cǎiyòng sùyǎ zhìpǔ de huīsè zhuānwǎ. Zhè zhǒng xíguàn tǐxiàn le gǔdài yánmì de lǐzhì děngjí.
extended_reading_passages.en: In the architectural codes of old Beijing quadrangles, building materials were usually determined by the homeowner's social status. Princely mansions usually featured fine white stone pedestals and glazed tiles, whereas common residences usually utilized modest grey bricks.
extended_reading_passages.es: En los códigos constructivos de los patios de Pekín, los materiales solían definirse por el rango social del propietario. Los palacios nobiliarios solían emplear zócalos de piedra blanca y tejas esmaltadas, mientras que los hogares plebeyos recurrían al ladrillo gris.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 民间日常邻里交往也通常恪守传统的谦让礼俗。逢年过节，街坊之间通常会互赠亲手制作的应节糕点。若有外来客人登门拜访，主人通常会以最高礼节奉上盖碗茉莉花茶。这些看似平常的举动，深藏着古都街巷独特的淳朴民风与人情滋味。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mínjiān rìcháng línlǐ jiāowǎng yě tōngcháng kèshǒu chuántǒng de qiānràng lǐsú. Féng nián guò jié, jiēfang zhījiān tōngcháng huì hù zèng qīnshǒu zhìzuò de yìngjié gāodiǎn. Ruò yǒu wàilái kèrén dēngmén bàifǎng, zhǔrén tōngcháng huì yǐ zuìgāo lǐjié fèngshang gàiwǎn mòlihuā chá. Zhèxiē kànsì píngcháng de jǔdòng, shēncáng zhe gǔdū jiēxiàng dútè de chúnpǔ mínfēng yǔ rénqíng zīwèi.
extended_reading_passages.en: Daily neighborhood interactions among civilians also usually strictly observed traditional polite customs. During festivals, neighbors usually exchanged homemade seasonal cakes. When outside guests arrived, hosts usually offered covered-bowl jasmine tea with highest etiquette.
extended_reading_passages.es: Las relaciones vecinales cotidianas solían observar con esmero la cortesía tradicional. En festividades, los vecinos solían regalarse dulces típicos caseros. Ante la llegada de visitas, el anfitrión servía té de jazmín en cuenco con reverencia, reflejando la entrañable hospitalidad pekinesa.

meanings_summary.es: yuxtaponer; alinearse; empatar; estar en el mismo plano

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Standing side by side (并) aligned in an orderly rank (列) signifies parallel juxtaposition (并列).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Estar hombro con hombro (并) alineados en rigurosa hilera (列) define la yuxtaposición paritaria (并列).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Derived from classical military formations and grammatical coordinates where neither term subordinates the other.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Double fourth tone: 'bìng liè' (51-51). Deliver both syllables with crisp, sharp downward inflection.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 并列 emphasizes equal rank, simultaneous presence, or horizontal non-hierarchical juxtaposition.

contrasts.analysis: 从属 denotes hierarchical subordination where one relies on the master, while 并列 denotes equal status.
递进 marks step-by-step sequential escalation in intensity, whereas 并列 treats all items on the same plane.
交叉 involves intersecting or overlapping paths, whereas 并列 features parallel non-intersecting lines.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Grid lines without top horizontal dot strokes
Horizontal bar across two vertical supports
Person radical 亻 to the left of 列
Four fire dots 灬 below 列

senses.definition_en: to be placed side by side; to rank equally without distinction of superior and inferior
senses.definition_es: colocarse uno al lado del otro; alinearse en el mismo rango o igualdad de condiciones
senses.example_phrase: 并列第一名 (tie for first place)

example_sentences.hanzi: 在老北京四合院的规整格局中，东厢房与西厢房分立在庭院两侧，形成了整齐并列的对称之美。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài lǎo Běijīng sìhéyuàn de guīzhěng géjú zhōng, dōngxiāngfáng yǔ xīxiāngfáng fēnlì zài tíngyuàn liǎngcè, xíngchéng le zhěngqí bìngliè de duìchèn zhī měi.
example_sentences.en: In the orderly layout of old Beijing quadrangles, east and west wing-rooms stand on either side of the courtyard, forming a neatly juxtaposed symmetrical aesthetic.
example_sentences.es: En la ordenada traza del siheyuan pekinés, las alas este y oeste se alzan a ambos flancos del patio, creando una equilibrada belleza simétrica yuxtapuesta.

example_sentences.hanzi: 两位青年学者凭借开创性的理论研究成果，在今年的学术年会上并列荣获一等奖。
example_sentences.pinyin: Liǎng wèi qīngnián xuézhě píngjiè kāichuàngxìng de lǐlùn yánjiū chéngguǒ, zài jīntiān de xuéshù niánhuì shang bìngliè rónghuò yīděngjiǎng.
example_sentences.en: Two young scholars jointly won the first prize in a tie at this year's academic symposium for their groundbreaking theoretical findings.
example_sentences.es: Dos jóvenes investigadores obtuvieron conjuntamente el primer premio en pie de igualdad en el congreso científico gracias a sus innovadoras teorías.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A sharp knife 刂 segmenting bone fragments into an orderly row or sequence; line up.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Emplear una hoja afilada (刂) para separar elementos en una hilera ordenada (列).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国传统院落的规划非常讲究对称并列。在四合院内部，东西两侧的厢房无论在进深、开间还是屋顶造型上，都保持着高度的并列对应。这种左右对称的建筑格局，营造出一种端正庄重的居住秩序。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó chuántǒng yuànluò de guīhuà fēicháng jiǎngjiu duìchèn bìngliè. Zài sìhéyuàn nèibù, dōngxī liǎngcè de xiāngfáng wúlùn zài jìnshēn, kāijiān háishì wūdǐng zàoxíng shang, dōu bǎochí zhe gāodù de bìngliè duìyìng. Zhè zhǒng zuǒyòu duìchèn de jiànzhù géjú, yíngzào chū yī zhǒng duānzhèng zhuāngzhòng de jūzhù zhìxù.
extended_reading_passages.en: The planning of traditional Chinese courtyards emphasized symmetry and parallel layout. Inside a quadrangle, the east and west wings maintained high coordinate correspondence in depth, span, and roof styling, forging an orderly dignity.
extended_reading_passages.es: La traza del patio tradicional chino concede enorme importancia a la simetría y alineación. Las alas este y oeste guardaban estricta concordancia en profundidad, crujías y techumbres, forjando un orden residencial solemne.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在汉语语法构造中，并列短语是由两个或两个以上地位平等的词汇共同组合而成的。它们之间没有修饰与被修饰的依附关系，表达的意思互为补充。学会准确识别并列关系，有助于深入理解古代诗词与现代美文的精妙对仗。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài Hànyǔ yǔfǎ gòuzào zhōng, bìngliè duǎnyǔ shì yóu liǎng gè huò liǎng gè yǐshàng dìwèi píngděng de cíhuì gòngtóng zǔhé ér chéng de. Tāmen zhījiān méiyǒu xiūshì yǔ bèi xiūshì de yīfù guānxi, biǎodá de yìsi hù wéi bǔchōng. Xuéhuì zhǔnquè shíbié bìngliè guānxi, yǒuzhùyú shēnrù lǐjiě gǔdài shīcí yǔ xiàndài měiwén de jīngmiào duìzhàng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In Chinese grammatical syntax, coordinate phrases are composed of two or more words of equal standing. They share no subordinate modifying relationship and complement each other, enabling learners to appreciate poetic parallelism.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la sintaxis gramatical china, los sintagmas coordinados se componen de términos de idéntica jerarquía. No guardan dependencia de subordinación sino que se complementan, permitiendo apreciar el pulcro paralelismo poético.

meanings_summary.es: componer; formar; constituir; conformar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Weaving threads together (组) to accomplish a completed structure (成) means to compose or form (组成).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Entrelazar hebras (组) hasta culminar una estructura completa (成) conforma el acto de componer (组成).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Originates from weaving terminology where separate strands unite into strong textiles, applied to systems and groups.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Third tone to second tone: 'zǔ chéng' (214-35). Dip the voice deeply on 'zǔ' and soar smoothly on 'chéng'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 组成 stresses the dynamic assembly or structural parts comprising an integrated whole.

contrasts.analysis: 构成 focuses more on abstract structural formation or legal elements, whereas 组成 often deals with tangible components or teams.
组织 denotes the managerial act of coordinating people or an enterprise, while 组成 states the compositional ingredients.
拆散 is the complete direct antonym meaning to dismantle or break up an assembled entity.

Grain radical 禾 on the left instead of 纟

senses.definition_en: to combine individual elements or members together into a coherent whole or organization
senses.definition_es: combinar elementos o integrantes individuales para formar un todo u organización
senses.example_phrase: 由……组成 (be composed of ...)

example_sentences.hanzi: 经典的北京四合院由正房、倒座房以及东西两座对称的厢房组合围成，形式浑然一体。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīngdiǎn de Běijīng sìhéyuàn yóu zhèngfáng, dàozuòfáng yǐjí dōngxī liǎng zuò duìchèn de xiāngfáng zǔhé wéichéng, xíngshì húnrányītǐ.
example_sentences.en: The classic Beijing courtyard is formed by the main room, reverse front room, and two symmetrical side wings, creating an integrated whole.
example_sentences.es: El clásico patio pekinés está constituido por la sala principal, la habitación frontal y dos alas laterales simétricas, formando una unidad armónica.

example_sentences.hanzi: 本次联合考察队由地质勘探专家、生物学者以及数位资深摄影师共同组成。
example_sentences.pinyin: Běncì liánhé kǎocháduì yóu dìzhì kāntàn zhuānjiā, shēngwù xuézhě yǐjí shù wèi zīshēn shèyǐngshī gòngtóng zǔchéng.
example_sentences.en: This joint expedition team is composed of geological survey specialists, biologists, and several veteran photographers.
example_sentences.es: La expedición conjunta está integrada por especialistas en exploración geológica, biólogos y varios fotógrafos experimentados.

idioms.meaning_en: grains of sand build a pagoda; small efforts accumulate to big feats
unity of will forms an impregnable fortress
fuse into an indivisible whole
complement and reinforce each other

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 纟 (threads/cords) + 且 (ancestral altar/heaping stones)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Silken cords 纟 woven and tied together around ceremonial markers 且; to organize into a firm group.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Weaving silk strings (纟) into neat patterned bands to unite members into a group (组).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Trenzar cordones de seda (纟) en bandas uniformes para congregar miembros en un grupo (组).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 戊 (weapon / axe) + 丁 (striking pin / nail)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A warrior completing a task through decisive action with a halberd 戈; signifies completion.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Using a weapon tool (戈) decisively to accomplish and finish a great work (成).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Blandir la alabarda (戈) con determinación para culminar y completar una gran obra (成).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国传统四合院建筑的奇妙之处，在于它由几个独立单体建筑巧妙组成。正房、厢房与门楼通过抄手游廊相互勾连，共同组成一个围合的天井庭院。各个部分各司其职，在空间上形成紧密呼应的和谐整体。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó chuántǒng sìhéyuàn jiànzhù de qímiào zhīchù, zàiyú tā yóu jǐ gè dúlì dāntǐ jiànzhù qiǎomiào zǔchéng. Zhèngfáng, xiāngfáng yǔ ménlóu tōngguò chāoshǒu yóuláng xiānghù gōulián, gòngtóng zǔchéng yī gè wéihé de tiānjǐng tíngyuàn. Gègè bùfen gè sī qí zhí, zài kōngjiān shang xíngchéng jǐnmì hūyìng de héxié zhěngtǐ.
extended_reading_passages.en: The wonder of traditional Chinese courtyards lies in being cleverly composed of several independent individual buildings. The main room, wings, and gatehouse connect via covered verandas, together forming an enclosed courtyard.
extended_reading_passages.es: La maravilla del siheyuan estriba en componerse ingeniosamente de varios edificios independientes. La sala principal, las alas y el pórtico se enlazan mediante galerías, conformando un patio cerrado que armoniza en un todo solidario.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代科学视角下，任何繁复的物质系统都是由微小基础单元组成的。比如细胞由生物分子组成，大厦由砖石钢筋组成，精密的计算机程序由一行行逻辑代码组成。理解了基础组成的规律，就能在复杂现象中把握本质。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài kēxué shìjiǎo xià, rènhé fánfù de wùzhì xìtǒng dōu shì yóu wēixiǎo jīchǔ dānyuán zǔchéng de. Bǐrú xìbāo yóu shēngwù fēnzǐ zǔchéng, dàshà yóu zhuānshí gāngjīn zǔchéng, jīngmì de jìsuànjī chéngxù yóu yī háng háng luóji dàimǎ zǔchéng. Lǐjiě le jīchǔ zǔchéng de guīlǜ, jiù néng zài fùzá xiànxiàng zhōng bǎwò běnzhì.
extended_reading_passages.en: From the perspective of modern science, any complex physical system is composed of tiny fundamental units. Cells are made of molecules, towers composed of bricks and steel, and programs composed of code. Grasping these basic components clarifies the essence.
extended_reading_passages.es: Bajo la mirada científica moderna, todo sistema complejo se compone de diminutas unidades básicas: las células se componen de biomoléculas, los edificios de acero y piedra, y el software de líneas de código lógico.

meanings_summary.es: generación mayor; parientes mayores; mayores de la familia

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A wise senior elder (长) seated in the honored carriage rank of the generation (辈) is a clan elder (长辈).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un anciano venerable (长) en el carruaje de honor de su generación (辈) encarna a los mayores de la familia (长辈).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Deeply anchored in Confucian filial culture where generational seniority dictates domestic protocol and housing arrangements.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Third tone to fourth tone: 'zhǎng bèi' (214-51). Lower the pitch on 'zhǎng', then drop with resolute emphasis on 'bèi'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 长辈 specifically designates relatives of older generations within the domestic family tree.

contrasts.analysis: 长辈 is strictly restricted to family genealogical lineages, whereas 前辈 refers to career mentors or professional seniors.
晚辈 is the direct genealogical antonym meaning descendants or family members of junior generations.
老人 denotes any elderly person based on chronological age, whereas 长辈 is strictly a relational genealogical rank.

senses.definition_en: family members or relatives belonging to an older generation than oneself
senses.definition_es: miembros de la familia o parientes pertenecientes a una generación superior a la propia
senses.example_phrase: 尊敬长辈 (respect one's elders)

example_sentences.hanzi: 四合院的建筑规制处处体现孝道，最好的正房总是安排给家中的长辈安居颐养。
example_sentences.pinyin: Sìhéyuàn de jiànzhù guīzhì chùchù tǐxiàn xiàodào, zuì hǎo de zhèngfáng zǒngshì ānpái gěi jiāzhōng de zhǎngbèi ānjū yíyǎng.
example_sentences.en: The architectural layout of courtyards embodies filial piety everywhere, with the finest main room always allocated to family elders for rest.
example_sentences.es: La disposición espacial del siheyuan refleja la piedad filial en cada detalle, asignando siempre la mejor estancia a los mayores de la familia.

example_sentences.hanzi: 逢年过节阖家团聚时，晚辈们都会毕恭毕敬地向长辈敬茶拜年，互道安康祝福。
example_sentences.pinyin: Féng nián guò jié héjiā tuánjù shí, wǎnbèi men dōu huì bìgōngbìjìng de xiàng zhǎngbèi jìng chá bàinián, hù dào ānkāng zhùfú.
example_sentences.en: During festival family reunions, younger generations respectfully serve tea to elders and offer New Year greetings wishing them good health.
example_sentences.es: En las reuniones familiares festivas, los jóvenes sirven té con sumo respeto a los mayores y les desean prosperidad y salud para el nuevo año.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在老北京的四合院里，长辈享有崇高的家庭地位。坐北朝南的正房冬暖夏凉、宽敞明亮，理所当然由长辈居住。清晨晚辈们都要先到正房向长辈请安，这种严谨的起居秩序构成了传统家族亲情的核心纽带。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài lǎo Běijīng de sìhéyuàn lǐ, zhǎngbèi xiǎngyǒu chónggāo de jiātíng dìwèi. Zuòběi cháonán de zhèngfáng dōngnuǎn xiàliáng, kuānchǎng míngliàng, lǐsuǒdāngrán yóu zhǎngbèi jūzhù. Qīngchén wǎnbèi men dōu yào xiān dào zhèngfáng xiàng zhǎngbèi qǐng'ān, zhè zhǒng yánjǐn de qǐjū zhìxù gòuchéng le chuántǒng jiāzú qīnqíng de héxīn niǔdài.
extended_reading_passages.en: In old Beijing courtyards, elders held lofty status within the clan. The spacious, sunlit main room facing south was naturally reserved for them. Juniors greeted elders every morning, forming the core bond of traditional familial affection.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el siheyuan pekinés, los mayores gozaban de veneración familiar. La sala principal, cálida en invierno y luminosa, les correspondía por derecho. El saludo matutino de los jóvenes afianzaba los lazos del linaje tradicional.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国传统家训十分强调对长辈的理解与体贴。随着年岁渐长，长辈的体力和精力大不如前，晚辈不仅要在物质生活上悉心照料长辈的起居，更要在精神上多陪伴倾听。尊重长辈的人生沉淀，是文明薪火相传的重要基石。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó chuántǒng jiāxùn shífēn qiángdiào duì zhǎngbèi de lǐjiě yǔ tǐtiē. Suízhe niánsuì jiàn zhǎng, zhǎngbèi de tǐlì yǔ jīnglì dà bù rú qián, wǎnbèi bùjǐn yào zài wùzhì shēnghuó shang xīxīn zhàoliào zhǎngbèi de qǐjū, gèng yào zài jīngshén shang duō péibàn qīngtīng. Zūnzhòng zhǎngbèi de rénshēng chéndiàn, shì wénmíng xīnhuǒ xiāngchuán de zhòngyào jīshí.
extended_reading_passages.en: Chinese familial precepts emphasize empathy and attentiveness toward elders. As age advances, juniors must not only provide physical care for elders' daily routine, but also offer patient companionship and listening to preserve generational wisdom.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los preceptos familiares chinos inculcan ternura hacia los mayores. Con el paso de los años, los jóvenes no solo deben velar por su bienestar cotidiano, sino brindarles afecto y escucha para perpetuar la sabiduría del linaje.

meanings_summary.en: to possess; have; be equipped with (qualifications/conditions)
meanings_summary.es: poseer; contar con; reunir; estar provisto de

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Holding all necessary tools (具) and being fully prepared (备) means one possesses (具备) all requisites.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Disponer de las herramientas (具) y hallarse enteramente preparado (备) implica poseer lo indispensable (具备).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Derived from classical statecraft where a city or army must possess both implements (具) and provisions (备) before setting out.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Double fourth tone: 'jù bèi' (51-51). Articulate both syllables with decisive firmness.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 具备 signifies possessing non-material qualifications, capabilities, prerequisites, or essential traits.

contrasts.analysis: 具有 is broader and can describe intrinsic natural features or qualities, while 具备 specifically implies meeting required conditions or criteria.
拥有 often applies to material wealth, vast assets, or large populations, whereas 具备 targets qualifying standards.
缺乏 is the direct antonym meaning to fall short of or lack necessary components.

senses.definition_en: to possess or be provided with necessary conditions, qualities, capabilities, or equipment
senses.definition_es: poseer o estar provisto de las condiciones, cualidades o medios indispensables
senses.example_phrase: 具备条件 (possess the necessary conditions)

example_sentences.hanzi: 现代化改造后的传统四合院，既保留了古典建筑风貌，又具备了先进完备的生活设施。
example_sentences.pinyin: Xiàndàihuà gǎizào hòu de chuántǒng sìhéyuàn, jì bǎoliú le gǔdiǎn jiànzhù fēngmào, yòu jùbèi le xiānjìn wánbèi de shēnghuó shèshī.
example_sentences.en: The modernly renovated traditional courtyard retains classical architecture while possessing advanced, complete living amenities.
example_sentences.es: Tras su remodelación, el patio tradicional preserva su porte clásico a la par que cuenta con avanzadas y completas instalaciones modernas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 申请海外高水平科研基金的候选人，必须具备扎实的专业理论功底与突出的外语交流能力。
example_sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng hǎiwài gāoshuǐpíng kēyán jījīn de hòuxuǎnrén, bìxū jùbèi zhāshi de zhuānyè lǐlùn gōngdǐ yǔ tūchū de wàiyǔ jiāoliú nénglì.
example_sentences.en: Candidates applying for advanced overseas research funds must possess solid professional theoretical foundation and outstanding foreign language skills.
example_sentences.es: Los postulantes a fondos científicos internacionales deben poseer una sólida base teórica y sobresaliente solvencia en idiomas extranjeros.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 一座理想的中国古典民居，往往具备冬暖夏凉的微气候调节能力。四合院高耸的青砖实心外墙具备优良的保温隔热性能，院内的绿植与水池则具备增加湿度与调节气温的作用，使居民享受到舒适的生活环境。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yī zuò lǐxiǎng de Zhōngguó gǔdiǎn mínjū, wǎngwǎng jùbèi dōngnuǎn xiàliáng de wēi qìhòu tiáojié nénglì. Sìhéyuàn gāosǒng de qīngzhuān shíxīn wàiqiáng jùbèi yōuliáng de bǎowēn gérè xìngnéng, yuànnèi de lǜzhí yǔ shuǐchí zé jùbèi zēngjiā shīdù yǔ tiáojié qìwēn de zuòyòng, shǐ jūmín xiǎngshòu dào shūshì de shēnghuó huánjìng.
extended_reading_passages.en: An ideal classical dwelling possesses microclimate regulation capabilities keeping it warm in winter and cool in summer. Its brick perimeter walls possess insulation performance, while greenery balances humidity and temperature.
extended_reading_passages.es: Una vivienda clásica ideal reúne facultades para regular su microclima térmico. Los gruesos muros de ladrillo del siheyuan poseen aislamiento superior, y su vegetación y estanques modulan la humedad para el bienestar vecinal.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在当今瞬息万变的全球化时代，优秀的复合型人才必须具备多维度的跨文化综合素质。他们不仅需要具备扎实深厚的本学科专业功底，更要具备宽广包容的国际视野与敏锐的批判性思维。具备这些卓越素质，方能引领前沿创新。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài dāngjīn shùnxī-wànbiàn de quánqiúhuà shídài, yōuxiù de fùhéxíng réncái bìxū jùbèi duōwéidù de kuà wénhuà zōnghé sùzhì. Tāmen bùjǐn xūyào jùbèi zhāshi shēnhòu de běn xuékē zhuānyè gōngdǐ, gèng yào jùbèi kuānguǎng bāoróng de guójì shìyě yǔ mǐnruì de pīpànxìng sīwéi. Jùbèi zhèxiē zhuóyuè sùzhì, fāng néng yǐnlǐng qiányán chuàngxīn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In today's fast-changing globalized era, multifaceted talents must possess comprehensive cross-cultural qualities. They must possess solid grounding in their field, an inclusive international vision, and sharp critical thinking to drive innovation.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la cambiante era global, los talentos multidisciplinares deben reunir aptitudes interculturales complejas. Requieren contar con hondos saberes profesionales, visión integradora y pensamiento crítico para liderar la innovación.

meanings_summary.es: diario; cotidiano; del día a día; ordinario

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: What repeats with each rising sun (日) as a constant custom (常) is everyday daily life (日常).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Aquello que retorna con cada nuevo sol (日) como pauta constante (常) conforma lo cotidiano (日常).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Captures the rhythmic cadence of agricultural society revolving around the solar cycle and routine chores.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Fourth tone to second tone: 'rì cháng' (51-35). Drop abruptly on 'rì' and glide smoothly up on 'cháng'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 日常 characterizes mundane, regular day-to-day matters as opposed to formal, rare, or festive occasions.

contrasts.analysis: 节日 marks extraordinary celebratory holidays, contrasting with normal uninterrupted 日常 routines.
特殊 designates rare or exceptional deviations, while 日常 describes habitual default states.
偶尔 refers to sporadic occurrences, whereas 日常 represents constant diurnal rhythm.
