example_sentences.hanzi: 居住在胡同四合院里的居民，在葡萄架下喝茶下棋，享受着平静而惬意的日常时光。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jūzhù zài hútòng sìhéyuàn lǐ de jūmín, zài pútáojià xià hē chá xià qí, xiǎngshòu zhe píngjìng ér qièyì de rìcháng shíguāng.
example_sentences.en: Residents living in alley quadrangles sip tea and play chess beneath grape trellises, savoring peaceful everyday moments.
example_sentences.es: Los vecinos de los patios beben té y juegan al ajedrez bajo emparrados de vid, saboreando el sosiego de la vida cotidiana.

example_sentences.hanzi: 掌握基本的地道汉语日常口语，是外国留学生快速融入中国大学校园生活的关键。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhǎngwò jīběn de dìdao Hànyǔ rìcháng kǒuyǔ, shì wàiguó liúxuéshēng kuàisù róngrù Zhōngguó dàxué xiàoyuán shēnghuó de guānjiàn.
example_sentences.en: Mastering authentic daily spoken Chinese is key for foreign students to integrate smoothly into campus life in China.
example_sentences.es: Dominar expresiones chinas coloquiales de uso diario resulta clave para que los estudiantes extranjeros se integren en la vida universitaria.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un estandarte textil (巾) fijado permanentemente como testimonio de lo habitual (常).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 四合院内部的空间格局巧妙兼顾了家庭成员的日常隐私与集体交往。封闭的高墙将外界的喧嚣隔绝开来，让一家人能够在庭院中自在地处理日常琐事，晾晒衣物、养花逗鸟，享受充满人间烟火气的惬意生活。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Sìhéyuàn nèibù de kōngjiān géjú qiǎomiào jiāngù le jiātíng chéngyuán de rìcháng yǐnsī yǔ jítǐ jiāowǎng. Fēngbì de gāoqiáng jiāng wàijiè de xuānxīao géjué kāi lái, ràng yī jiā rén nénggòu zài tíngyuàn zhōng zìzài de chǔlǐ rìcháng suǒshì, liàngshài yīwù, yǎng huā dòu niǎo, xiǎngshòu chōngmǎn rénjiān yānhuǒqì de qièyì shēnghuó.
extended_reading_passages.en: The spatial layout of courtyards skillfully balances everyday family privacy and collective interaction. Enclosing high walls block outside noise, allowing families to attend to daily domestic chores, air laundry, and tend flowers in comfort.
extended_reading_passages.es: El diseño espacial del siheyuan armoniza la intimidad cotidiana familiar y la convivencia colectiva. Altos muros aíslan el bullicio exterior, permitiendo atender faenas domésticas, secar ropa y cuidar aves en agradable sosiego.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 现代人的生活节奏飞快，常常在忙碌的奔波中忽略了平凡日常的美好。其实，清晨的一缕暖阳、午后的一杯清茶、傍晚与家人共进的一顿热饭，都是日常中最真实动人的幸福。用心体验日常点滴，才能收获内心的宁静与从容。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xiàndài rén de shēnghuó jiézòu fēikuài, chángcháng zài mánglù de bēnbō zhōng hūlüè le píngfán rìcháng de měihǎo. Qíshí, qīngchén de yī lǚ nuǎnyáng, wǔhòu de yī bēi qīngchá, bàngwǎn yǔ jiārén gòng jìn de yī dùn rè fàn, dōu shì rìcháng zhōng zuì zhēnshí dòngrén de xìngfú. Yòngxīn tǐyàn rìcháng diǎndī, cái néng shōuhuò nèixīn de níngjìng yǔ cóngróng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Modern life moves briskly, often causing people to overlook the quiet beauty of ordinary everyday living. The morning warmth, an afternoon cup of tea, and an evening dinner with family are the most authentic joys in daily existence.
extended_reading_passages.es: El vertiginoso ritmo actual suele hacer olvidar la belleza de lo cotidiano. El sol matinal, una taza de té y una cena compartida en familia constituyen las dichas más genuinas del día a día, colmando el alma de paz.

meanings_summary.en: daily life; daily routine; rise and rest
meanings_summary.es: vida cotidiana; rutina diaria; descanso y actividad diaria

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Rising at dawn (起) and returning home to rest (居) forms one's whole daily routine of living (起居).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Levantarse al alba (起) y reposar en el hogar (居) sintetiza el ciclo vital de la rutina cotidiana (起居).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Derives from ancient medical and imperial records ('起居注') documenting emperors' and scholars' daily movements and rest.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Third tone to first tone: 'qǐ jū' (214-55). Dip deeply on 'qǐ' and finish with an elevated steady tone on 'jū'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 起居 highlights the biological and domestic rhythm of waking, retiring, and maintaining bodily habits.

contrasts.analysis: 饮食 covers drinking and dining nutrition, whereas 起居 emphasizes sleep, rest, and mobility.
作息 focuses narrowly on timetable schedules between work and breaks, while 起居 encompasses full domestic comfort.
劳碌 expresses relentless draining toil, contrasting with peaceful, orderly 起居.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Shield radical 干 instead of 己
Halberd radical 戉 inside instead of 己
Knife radical 刂 on the right of 居
Hand radical 扌 on the left of 居

senses.definition_en: one's daily regimen of waking, resting, eating, and living; routine schedule of domestic existence
senses.definition_es: régimen diario de vigilia, descanso, alimentación y quehaceres habituales
senses.example_phrase: 照顾起居 (take care of someone's daily routine)

example_sentences.hanzi: 北京四合院的各栋房舍分工极具智慧，科学周全地照顾到了全家老小的日常起居生活。
example_sentences.pinyin: Běijīng sìhéyuàn de gè dòng fángshè fēngōng jí jù zhìhuì, kēxué zhōuquán de zhàogù dào le quánjiā lǎoxiǎo de rìcháng qǐjū shēnghuó.
example_sentences.en: The various wings of Beijing quadrangles were wisely planned, accommodating the daily routine and living needs of the whole family comprehensively.
example_sentences.es: Las estancias del siheyuan pekinés reflejan gran prudencia distributiva, atendiendo de forma metódica la vida y descanso cotidiano de la familia.

example_sentences.hanzi: 医生建议术后康复期的患者务必保持规律的起居作息，切忌熬夜劳累或饮食失调。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì shùhòu kāngfùqī de huànzhě wùbì bǎochí guīlǜ de qǐjū zuòxī, qièjì áoyè láolèi huò yǐnshí shītiáo.
example_sentences.en: The physician recommended that post-operative patients maintain a regular daily schedule, avoiding late nights, fatigue, or irregular diet.
example_sentences.es: El médico aconsejó a los pacientes en convalecencia mantener una rutina regular de descanso y vigilia, evitando trasnochar o desórdenes alimentarios.

collocations.en: keep regular daily hours in rest and work
daily schedule of sleeping and rising

idioms.meaning_en: keep regular hours in work and rest
work from dawn till dusk; toil early and late
live in peace and work with contentment
make the world one's home; wander anywhere

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 走 (walking forward) + 己 (one's own body rising)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A person setting their body 己 into forward walking motion 走; to rise from bed and stand up.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Springing onto one's feet to walk (走) at the start of a fresh day (起).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Ponerse en pie sobre las propias piernas para caminar (走) al clarear el día (起).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 尸 (body seated in resting posture) + 古 (old ancestral hearth)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A human body 尸 reposing peacefully inside a time-honored shelter 古; to dwell and repose.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A person sheltered under an ancestral roof (尸) resting peacefully at home (居).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una persona cobijada bajo el alero familiar (尸) descansando en su morada (居).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国古代四合院建筑充分体现了天人合一的居住智慧。四面合围的庭院把自然的光照与四季的新鲜空气引入起居空间，让居住者在起居饮食之间时刻感受到节气的变换，营造出安详悠闲的传统生活节奏。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdiǎn sìhéyuàn jiànzhù chōngfèn tǐxiàn le tiānrén-héyī de jūzhù zhìhuì. Sìmiàn héwéi de tíngyuàn bǎ zìrán de guāngzhào yǔ sìjì de xīnxiān kōngqì yǐnrù qǐjū kōngjiān, ràng jūzhùzhě zài qǐjū yǐnshí zhījiān shíkè gǎnshòudào jiéqì de biànhuàn, yíngzào chū ānxiáng yōuxián de chuántǒng shēnghuó jiézòu.
extended_reading_passages.en: Classical courtyards embodied ancient wisdom of harmony between humanity and nature. The courtyard channeled sunlight and fresh air into daily living quarters, allowing inhabitants to perceive changing seasons throughout their daily routines.
extended_reading_passages.es: La arquitectura del siheyuan clásico refleja la armonía entre el hombre y el cosmos. Su patio canaliza luz natural y brisas hacia las estancias, permitiendo a los habitantes percibir las estaciones en su descanso y rutina diaria.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 传统养生学认为，起居有常是延年益寿的首要法则。顺应自然日月的更迭，日出而作、日落而息，保持良好的起居节律，不仅能够保养体内的气血精神，更能让心灵在宁静的作息中得到充分的滋养与放松。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chuántǒng yǎngshēngxué rènwéi, qǐjū yǒucháng shì yánnián-yìshòu de shǒuyào fǎzé. Shùnyìng zìrán rìyuè de gēngdié, rì chū ér zuò, rì luò ér xī, bǎochí liánghǎo de qǐjū jiélǜ, bùjǐn nénggòu bǎoyǎng tǐnèi de qìxuè jīngshén, gèng néng ràng xīnlíng zài níngjìng de zuòxī zhōng dédào chōngfèn de zīyǎng yǔ fàngsōng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Traditional wellness asserts that regular daily rising and resting hours are the foremost principle of longevity. Rising with the dawn and resting at dusk preserves vitality and nurtures peace of mind through balanced living.
extended_reading_passages.es: Las artes milenarias de la salud consideran que la regularidad en el descanso es ley primordial de longevidad. Despertar con el sol y reposar al anochecer templa la energía vital y serena el espíritu mediante un ritmo armónico.

meanings_summary.es: recibir; acoger; atender; hospedar (a huéspedes o visitantes)

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Welcoming with open hands (接) and treating hospitably (待) equals receiving guests (接待).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Dar la bienvenida con las manos (接) y agasajar con esmero (待) conforma el acto de acoger (接待).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Essential concept of traditional Chinese hospitality where hosts go out to the courtyard gate to receive visitors.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: First tone to fourth tone: 'jiē dài' (55-51). High steady pitch on 'jiē', followed by a crisp downward drop on 'dài'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 接待 implies formal or courteous hospitality shown to visitors, clients, or travelers.

contrasts.analysis: 招待 leans heavily toward serving food and drinks (banquets/feasts), while 接待 focuses on overall reception protocol.
迎接 is the physical action of going out to meet arriving guests, while 接待 encompasses the entire hosting process.
怠慢 is the direct antonym meaning to cold-shoulder or neglect visiting guests.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Safe radical 安 on the right instead of 妾
Lou radical 娄 on the right instead of 妾
Hand radical 扌 on left instead of step 彳
Person radical 亻 on left instead of 彳

senses.definition_en: to meet, receive, and accommodate guests, clients, or visiting delegations with hospitality
senses.definition_es: recibir, dar la bienvenida y atender con cortesía a invitados, clientes o delegaciones
senses.example_phrase: 热情接待 (receive warmly)

example_sentences.hanzi: 在老北京四合院中，正房正厅通常作为接待重要宾朋的客厅，以展现主人的热情与礼仪。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài lǎo Běijīng sìhéyuàn zhōng, zhèngfáng zhèngtīng tōngcháng zuòwéi jiēdài zhòngyào bīnpéng de kètīng, yǐ zhǎnxiàn zhǔrén de rèqíng yǔ lǐyí.
example_sentences.en: In old Beijing courtyards, the central hall of the main building served as a parlor to receive important guests with warmth and etiquette.
example_sentences.es: En el siheyuan pekinés, la sala central del pabellón principal servía de salón para recibir a visitantes ilustres con calidez y cortesía.

example_sentences.hanzi: 本届博览会的主办方设立了专业的多语种接待中心，全天候为各国展商提供周到细致的服务。
example_sentences.pinyin: Běnjiè bólǎnhuì de zhǔbànfāng shèlì le zhuānyè de duōyǔzhǒng jiēdài zhōngxīn, quántiānhòu wèi gèguó zhǎnshāng tígōng zhōudào xìzhì de fúwù.
example_sentences.en: The organizers of the expo established a professional multilingual reception center to provide attentive service to international exhibitors round the clock.
example_sentences.es: Los organizadores de la exposición inauguraron un centro de recepción multilingüe para brindar atención solícita a expositores internacionales.

idioms.meaning_en: refined and courteous in manners
extremely polite and cordial
leave the seat of honor vacant to welcome worthy guests
sweep the couch clean to receive esteemed guests

character_decomposition.meaning_es: recibir; conectar; tomar el relevo; encontrarse
character_decomposition.meaning_component: 扌 (hand reaching out) + 妾 (woman bowing in reception)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Extending a welcoming hand 扌 forward to meet and connect with another person; to receive.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Reaching out open hands (扌) warmly to welcome a visitor across the threshold (接).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Extender las manos abiertas (扌) con afecto para recibir a un viajero en el umbral (接).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 彳 (step along walkway) + 寺 (monastery/court hall with hand hold)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Waiting along a ceremonial hall path 彳 to attend upon arriving guests 寺 with dignified hospitality.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Stepping out onto the porch (彳) to attend to and treat a waited guest with care (待).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Avanzar unos pasos por el porche (彳) para acoger y agasajar al huésped esperado (待).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 老北京四合院的建筑格局对接待客人有着极为明确的礼仪界限。普通访客通常在外院倒座房接待，而尊贵挚友才会被请入内院正房品茗叙旧。这种层次分明的接待规制，体现了中国古人内外有别的待客智慧。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Lǎo Běijīng sìhéyuàn de jiànzhù géjú duì jiēdài kèrén yǒu zhe jíwéi míngquè de lǐyí jièxiàn. Pǔtōng fǎngkè tōngcháng zài wàiyuàn dàozuòfáng jiēdài, ér zūnguì zhìyǒu cái huì bèi qǐng rù nèiyuàn zhèngfáng pǐnmíng xùjiù. Zhè zhǒng céngcì fēnmíng de jiēdài guīzhì, tǐxiàn le Zhōngguó gǔrén nèiwài-yǒubié de dàikè zhìhuì.
extended_reading_passages.en: The architectural layout of old Beijing quadrangles had clear etiquette boundaries for receiving guests. Ordinary visitors were received in outer gate rooms, while honored friends entered the inner courtyard parlor, showing refined hospitality codes.
extended_reading_passages.es: La distribución del siheyuan pekinés establecía límites ceremoniales para recibir visitas. Los visitantes corrientes eran atendidos en el patio exterior, mientras los allegados pasaban al salón interior, reflejando códigos de cortesía.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代涉外商务交流中，专业热情的接待往往能够为合作奠定坚实的信任基石。从机场迎接的真诚微笑，到会谈室中妥帖的茶水准备，每一个接待细节都在无声地传递着企业的文化素养。体贴入微的接待让远道而来的客户宾至如归。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài shèwài shāngwù jiāoliú zhōng, zhuānyè rèqíng de jiēdài wǎngwǎng nénggòu wèi hézuò diàndìng jiānshí de xìnrèn jīshí. Cóng jīchǎng yíngjiē de zhēnchéng wēixiào, dào huìtánshì zhōng tuǒtiē de cháshuǐ zhǔnbèi, měi yī gè jiēdài xìjié dōu zài wúshēng de chuándì zhe qǐyè de wénhuà sùyǎng. Tǐtiē-rùwēi de jiēdài ràng yuǎndào-érlái de kèhù bīnzhìrúguī.
extended_reading_passages.en: In modern foreign business relations, professional and warm reception lays a solid foundation of trust. From welcoming smiles at the airport to thoughtful amenities in the conference room, hospitable details make visiting clients feel truly at home.
extended_reading_passages.es: En las relaciones comerciales internacionales modernas, una acogida solícita sienta las bases de la confianza. Desde la sonrisa cordial en el aeropuerto hasta los pormenores en la sala de juntas, cada atención hace sentir al huésped en casa.

meanings_summary.es: función; capacidad; funcionalidad

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Work-merit (功) combined with inherent capability (能) creates an effective function (功能).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El fruto del trabajo (功) sumado a la facultad inherente (能) da lugar a la funcionalidad práctica (功能).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Blends Confucian practical efficacy (功用) with systemic capabilities, ubiquitous in modern engineering and biology.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: First tone to second tone: 'gōng néng' (55-35). Begin high and level, then lift dynamically upward.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 功能 points to the objective operating utility, purpose, or capacity designed into an entity.

contrasts.analysis: 作用 focuses on external consequences or effects exerted on something else, while 功能 is the intrinsic capability itself.
性能 measures the quality or benchmark of performance (e.g. engine speed), while 功能 lists the features.
缺陷 denotes structural bugs or flaws impairing an object's intended functionality.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Rap radical 攵 on the right instead of 力
Beg radical 丂 on the right instead of 力
Four fire dots 灬 under the 能 glyph
Heart radical 心 at bottom instead of full bear form

senses.definition_en: the specific purpose, natural capacity, or operational duty of an object, organ, or system
senses.definition_es: propósito específico, capacidad operativa o función determinada de un objeto, órgano o sistema
senses.example_phrase: 发挥功能 (bring one's function into play)

example_sentences.hanzi: 在四合院的四面建筑中，各个房屋具备明确而互补的起居功能，共同满足大家庭的生活需要。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài sìhéyuàn de sìmiàn jiànzhù zhōng, gègè fángwū jùbèi míngquè ér hùbǔ de qǐjū gōngnéng, gòngtóng mǎnzú dàjiātíng de shēnghuó xūyào.
example_sentences.en: Among the four-sided buildings of a courtyard, each room possessed clear, complementary living functions fulfilling the extended family's needs.
example_sentences.es: Entre las cuatro alas del patio, cada edificio reunía funciones residenciales precisas y complementarias para satisfacer a la familia extendida.

example_sentences.hanzi: 长期坚持适度的有氧运动，能够显著增强人体心肺系统的机能与免疫调节功能。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chángqī jiānchí shìdù de yǒuyǎng yùndòng, nénggòu xiǎnzhù zēngqiáng réntǐ xīnfèi xìtǒng de jīnéng yǔ miǎnyì tiáojié gōngnéng.
example_sentences.en: Consistently practicing moderate aerobic exercise over the long term can notably strengthen the cardiopulmonary capacity and immune regulatory functions.
example_sentences.es: La práctica continua de ejercicio aeróbico moderado fortalece notablemente el rendimiento cardiopulmonar y las funciones de regulación inmunológica.

idioms.meaning_en: each does one's utmost according to abilities
omnipotent; capable of doing anything
scope or battlefield to exercise one's talents
reputation deserved by actual merit

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 工 (work/carpenter's square) + 力 (physical strength)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Applying physical effort 力 to complete constructive craft work 工; signifies fruitful results.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Exerting strength (力) through skilled artisan craft (工) to produce fruitful work (功).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Aplicar la fuerza física (力) mediante el hábil trabajo artesanal (工) para lograr frutos útiles (功).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: pictograph of a powerful muscular bear with strong claws and jaw
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictograph of a bear with immense muscular endurance and prowess; signifies capability.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A vigorous bear possessing the raw strength and boundless ability (能) to climb high peaks.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un oso robusto provisto de gran fortaleza muscular y facultad para dominar cumbres (能).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 北京四合院的各处构件不仅造型优美，更蕴含着实用的物理功能。例如房顶上层层交错的筒瓦具备迅速排水与隔热遮阳的功能，庭院中央栽植的绿树则具备夏季遮阳、秋冬防风落叶的自然生态调节功能。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Běijīng sìhéyuàn de gèchù gòujiàn bùjǐn zàoxíng yōuměi, gèng yùnhán zhe shíyòng de wùlǐ gōngnéng. Lìrú fángdǐng shang céngcéng jiāocuò de tǒngwǎ jùbèi xùnsù páishuǐ yǔ gérè zhēyáng de gōngnéng, tíngyuàn zhōngyāng zāizhí de lǜshù zé jùbèi xiàjì zhēyáng, qiūdōng fángfēng luòyè de zìrán shēngtài tiáojié gōngnéng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Every element of Beijing quadrangles not only boasts graceful form, but also harbors practical physical functions. The overlapping roof tiles channel rapid drainage and insulation, while trees provide ecological shade and wind protection.
extended_reading_passages.es: Cada componente del siheyuan pekinés encierra una valiosa función física. Las tejas curvas del tejado canalizan el desagüe y aíslan del calor, mientras la arboleda del patio aporta sombra en estío y cortavientos en otoño.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 智能手机的发展史，正是设备功能不断高度集成的演进史。如今的移动通信设备早已超越了单纯的通话功能，兼备了专业摄影、移动办公以及实时健康监测等多重功能。强大的综合功能，深刻重塑了当代人类的生活图景。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhìnéng shǒujī de fāzhǎnshǐ, zhèngshì shèbèi gōngnéng bùduàn gāodù jíchéng de yǎnjìnshǐ. Rújīn de yídòng tōngxìn shèbèi zǎoyǐ chāoyuè le dānchún de tōnghuà gōngnéng, jiānbèi le zhuānyè shèyǐng, yídòng bàngōng yǐjí shíshí jiànkāng jiāncè děng duōchóng gōngnéng. Qiángdà de zōnghé gōngnéng, shēnkè zhòngsù le dāngdài rénlèi de shēnghuó tújǐng.
extended_reading_passages.en: The history of smartphones is an evolution of heightened functional integration. Modern mobile devices have surpassed mere voice calls to incorporate photography, remote office suites, and health metrics, reshaping modern living.
extended_reading_passages.es: La evolución del teléfono inteligente refleja una creciente convergencia de funcionalidades. Los terminales modernos van más allá de la telefonía para incorporar fotografía, trabajo en remoto y control de la salud, transformando la vida.

meanings_summary.es: ala lateral; habitación lateral del patio (en un siheyuan)

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A flanking side shelter (厢) built as a domestic room (房) forms a courtyard wing-room (厢房).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un pabellón lateral (厢) construido como estancia habitable (房) conforma el ala del patio (厢房).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: A cornerstone of classical courtyard layout embodying axial symmetry and Confucian generational housing rank.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: First tone to second tone: 'xiāng fáng' (55-35). Begin high and level, then glide smoothly up.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 厢房 refers specifically to the east and west flanking lateral wings of a courtyard compound.

contrasts.analysis: 正房 is the principal north-facing building reserved for elders, while 厢房 are secondary lateral flank buildings.
倒座房 sits along the southern perimeter facing north toward the courtyard, distinct from east-west 厢房.
耳房 are small ear-like adjoining annexes attached to the sides of the main room, not standalone lateral wings.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Bamboo radical 竹 on top instead of shelter 广
Lacks the enclosing shelter radical 广
Mound radical 阝 on left instead of single door 户
Earth radical 土 on left instead of single door 户

senses.definition_en: rooms built along the east and west flanks of a traditional Chinese quadrangle courtyard compound
senses.definition_es: estancias o pabellones dispuestos en los flancos este y oeste de un patio cuadrangular chino
senses.example_phrase: 东厢房与西厢房 (east wing-room and west wing-room)

example_sentences.hanzi: 在老北京四合院中，东厢房与西厢房面对面并列排布，通常分配给家中的儿女居住或作为书房。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài lǎo Běijīng sìhéyuàn zhōng, dōngxiāngfáng yǔ xīxiāngfáng miànduìmiàn bìngliè páibù, tōngcháng fēnpèi gěi jiāzhōng de érnǚ jūzhù huò zuòwéi shūfáng.
example_sentences.en: In old Beijing courtyards, the east and west wings stand face to face, traditionally assigned as residences for sons and daughters or as studies.
example_sentences.es: En el siheyuan pekinés, las alas este y oeste se disponen frente a frente, reservadas habitualmente para los hijos o como estudios familiares.

example_sentences.hanzi: 主人经过精心修缮，把原本堆放旧物的西厢房改造成了一间窗明几净、古色古香的客人茶室。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhǔrén jīngguò jīngxīn xiūshàn, bǎ yuánběn duīfàng jiùwù de xīxiāngfáng gǎizào chéng le yī jiān chuāngmíng-jǐjìng, gǔsè-gǔxiāng de kèrén cháshì.
example_sentences.en: After meticulous restoration, the owner renovated the west wing—once used for storage—into a spotless, classically styled tea room for guests.
example_sentences.es: Tras una esmerada rehabilitación, el dueño convirtió el ala oeste, otrora trastero, en un salón de té para invitados diáfano y de aire clásico.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A shelter 广 built alongside flanking rows 相 of trees and courtyards; represents flanking wing-rooms.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A roofed side wing (广) positioned face to face (相) across the garden courtyard (厢).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un ala techada (广) situada cara a cara (相) al otro lado del patio solariego (厢).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A domestic room accessed via a single front door 户 built atop a square lot 方; a room or chamber.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Pushing open a wooden single door (户) to enter an inviting square bedroom chamber (房).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Empujar una puerta de madera (户) para acceder a una acogedora estancia cuadrangular (房).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 四合院东西两侧的厢房，是维系传统家族生活的重要场所。按照长幼次序的旧礼，东厢房采光更加充足，地位略高于西厢房，多安排给长子居住。两座厢房隔院相对，既保持了各房的独立，又方便彼此照料走动。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Sìhéyuàn dōngxī liǎngcè de xiāngfáng, shì wéixì chuántǒng jiāzú shēnghuó de zhòngyào chǎngsuǒ. Ànzhào zhǎngyòu cìxù de jiùlǐ, dōngxiāngfáng cǎiguāng gèngjiā chōngzú, dìwèi lüègāo yú xīxiāngfáng, duō ānpái gěi zhǎngzǐ jūzhù. Liǎng zuò xiāngfáng gé yuàn xiāngduì, jì bǎochí le gè fáng de dúlì, yòu fāngbiàn bǐcǐ zhàoliào zǒudòng.
extended_reading_passages.en: The side wings on the east and west of a courtyard were crucial spaces sustaining traditional family life. By old customs, the east wing enjoyed better daylight and slightly higher rank, housing the eldest son. Facing across the yard, they maintained privacy while facilitating mutual care.
extended_reading_passages.es: Las alas este y oeste del siheyuan eran vitales para la convivencia familiar. Según la tradición, el ala este recibía mejor luz y rango, habitada por el primogénito. Enfrentadas a través del patio, aseguraban independencia y cercanía.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国古代著名的杂剧名作《西厢记》，正是发生在一座幽静寺院西厢房里的爱情传奇。崔莺莺与张生冲破封建礼教的重重禁锢，在月色映照下的西厢房里互诉衷肠。这出优美的经典戏剧，赋予了传统厢房无尽的诗意浪漫与文学底蕴。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài zhùmíng de zájù míngzuò Xīxiāngjì, zhèngshì fāshēng zài yī zuò yōujìng sìyuàn xīxiāngfáng lǐ de àiqíng chuánqí. Cuī Yīngyīng yǔ Zhāng Shēng chōngpò fēngjiàn lǐjiào de chóngchóng jìngù, zài yuèshè yìngzhào xià de xīxiāngfáng lǐ hù sù zhōngcháng. Zhè chū yōuměi de jīngdiǎn xìjù, fùyǔ le chuántǒng xiāngfáng wújìn de shīyì làngmàn yǔ wénxué dǐyùn.
extended_reading_passages.en: The famous ancient drama 'Romance of the Western Chamber' tells an enduring love legend unfolding in the west wing of a quiet temple. Cui Yingying and Zhang Sheng broke through feudal constraints under moonlight, infusing the term with timeless literary romance.
extended_reading_passages.es: El célebre drama clásico chino 'Romance del Pabellón Occidental' narra un romance en el ala oeste de un monasterio. Cui Yingying y Zhang Sheng desafiaron las ataduras feudales bajo la luna, impregnando este espacio de eterna poesía y romance literario.

meanings_summary.es: pasillo; corredor; galería cubierta; soportal

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Walking along (走) a sheltered colonnade veranda (廊) brings one through the courtyard corridor (走廊).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Caminar (走) al amparo de una galería columnada techada (廊) define el corredor o pasillo (走廊).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Essential element in classical Chinese garden and compound architecture, serving both practical transit and picturesque contemplation.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Third tone to second tone: 'zǒu láng' (214-35). Dip deep on 'zǒu' and rise melodiously on 'láng'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 走廊 emphasizes a covered indoor or veranda-style architectural transit passageway.

contrasts.analysis: 街道 refers to open public streets flanked by city shops, whereas 走廊 is a domestic or building corridor.
胡同 specifically designates northern Chinese city lanes between compounds, not an internal covered walkway.
大厅 is a wide stationary hall, whereas 走廊 is an elongated passageway connecting destinations.

senses.definition_en: a roofed passageway or corridor connecting rooms or buildings, often open on one or both sides
senses.definition_es: pasadizo o galería techada que comunica diversas habitaciones o pabellones
senses.example_phrase: 漫步在走廊上 (strolling along the corridor)

example_sentences.hanzi: 北京四合院里的抄手走廊将正房与东西厢房紧密相连，即使雨雪天气也能在各屋之间自如穿行。
example_sentences.pinyin: Běijīng sìhéyuàn lǐ de chāoshǒu zǒuláng jiāng zhèngfáng yǔ dōngxī xiāngfáng jǐnmì xiānglián, jíshǐ yǔxuě tiānqì yě néng zài gè wū zhījiān zìrú chuānxíng.
example_sentences.en: The covered verandas in Beijing courtyards connect the main room with the wings, allowing people to walk sheltered even during rain or snow.
example_sentences.es: Las galerías cubiertas del siheyuan pekinés conectan la sala principal con las alas, permitiendo circular a cubierto incluso con lluvia o nieve.

example_sentences.hanzi: 这栋现代办公大楼的中心走廊两侧，悬挂着许多展示企业发展历程的历史照片。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè dòng xiàndài bàngōng dàlóu de zhōngxīn zǒuláng liǎngcè, xuánguà zhe xǔduō zhǎnshì qǐyè fāzhǎn lìchéng de lìshǐ zhàopiàn.
example_sentences.en: Along both sides of the modern office building's central corridor hang numerous historical photographs detailing the company's evolution.
example_sentences.es: A ambos lados del pasillo central del moderno edificio corporativo cuelgan fotografías históricas que relatan la trayectoria de la empresa.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient oracle bone glyph depicting a person swinging arms while striding forward swiftly.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un caminante enérgico que bracea con determinación al andar (走).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 广 (broad rooftop shelter) + 郎 (lofty court pavilion)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A roofed colonnade 广 extending outward from noble pavilions 郎; denotes covered passageways.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A graceful overhanging roof shelter (广) lining the pavilion path to shield strollers (廊).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un elegante alero techado (广) que resguarda el sendero columnado de la galería (廊).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 老北京四合院的抄手游廊极富诗意。这道带顶的曲折走廊顺着院墙蜿蜒伸展，不仅遮挡烈日与骤雨，廊檐下的彩绘更如画卷般引人入胜。雨天漫步走廊，听屋檐滴水，看庭前花木，令人顿生无限雅兴。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Lǎo Běijīng sìhéyuàn de chāoshǒu yóuláng jí fù shīyì. Zhè dào dài dǐng de qūzhé zǒuláng shùnzhe yuànqiáng wānyán shēnzhǎn, bùjǐn zhēdǎng lièrì yǔ zhòuyǔ, lángyán xià de cǎihuì gèng rú huàjuàn bān yǐnrén-rùshèng. Yǔtiān mànbù zǒuláng, tīng wūyán dīshuǐ, kàn tíngqián huāmù, lìngrén dùn shēng wúxiàn yǎxìng.
extended_reading_passages.en: The covered veranda in old Beijing courtyards is intensely poetic. Winding along the compound wall, it shelters against sun and downpours, while vivid beam paintings resemble scrolls, turning rainy courtyard strolls into tranquil joy.
extended_reading_passages.es: La galería techada del siheyuan pekinés encierra una intensa poesía. Serpenteando junto al muro, resguarda del sol y aguaceros, mientras sus vigas policromadas emulan lienzos que invitan a contemplar la lluvia con serenidad.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代建筑设计与生态规划中，“绿色走廊”概念日益受到重视。设计师在林立的城市高楼之间打造通风采光的生态走廊，让候鸟迁徙与冷空气顺利流通，有效缓解了都市热岛效应，赋予了传统走廊更广阔的时代内涵。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài jiànzhù shèjì yǔ shēngtài guīhuà zhōng, 'lǜsè zǒuláng' gàiniàn rìyì shòudào zhòngshì. Shèjìshī zài línlì de chéngshì gāolóu zhījiān dǎzào tōngfēng cǎiguāng de shēngtài zǒuláng, ràng hòuniǎo qiānxǐ yǔ lěngkōngqì shùnlì liútōng, yǒuxiào huǎnjiě le dūshì rèdǎo xiàoyìng, fùyǔ le chuántǒng zǒuláng gèng guǎngkuò de shídài nèihán.
extended_reading_passages.en: In modern architecture and ecological planning, the concept of 'green corridors' receives growing attention. Urban planners weave breezeways among skyscrapers to enable bird migration and ventilation, mitigating urban heat islands.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la arquitectura contemporánea, el concepto de 'corredor verde' cobra relieve. Los urbanistas integran galerías ecológicas entre rascacielos para facilitar el vuelo de aves y la ventilación, atenuando las islas de calor urbano.

meanings_summary.es: espacio; amplitud; margen; espacio exterior

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Open expanse (空) opening between physical boundaries (间) defines three-dimensional space (空间).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La amplitud diáfana (空) que media entre límites físicos (间) conforma el espacio disponible (空间).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Paired with 'time' (时间) in Chinese metaphysics: 宇 (infinite space) and 宙 (infinite time), combining emptiness and boundary.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Double first tone: 'kōng jiān' (55-55). Maintain a clear, elevated, sustained tone across both syllables.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 空间 denotes three-dimensional physical room, clearance, or figurative scope for growth.

contrasts.analysis: 时间 governs the temporal dimension (hours, duration), while 空间 governs spatial dimensions (volume, area).
地点 pinpoint a specific geographic location, whereas 空间 emphasizes the internal volume or capacity.
拥挤 describes crowded conditions resulting from an acute shortage of 空间.

senses.definition_en: physical expanse or volume available for occupation; room for activity or growth; outer space
senses.definition_es: extensión física tridimensional disponible; cabida o margen para maniobra; cosmos
senses.example_phrase: 生活空间 (living space)

example_sentences.hanzi: 四合院中心宽敞明亮的天井，为一家老小提供了亲近自然、开展日常交往的开阔空间。
example_sentences.pinyin: Sìhéyuàn zhōngxīn kuānchǎng míngliàng de tiānjǐng, wèi yī jiā lǎoxiǎo tígōng le qīnjìn zìrán, kāizhǎn rìcháng jiāowǎng de kāikuò kōngjiān.
example_sentences.en: The spacious central courtyard provides the whole family with an expansive open space to commune with nature and engage in daily socializing.
example_sentences.es: El diáfano patio central del siheyuan brinda a la familia un holgado espacio al aire libre para convivir y disfrutar de la naturaleza.

example_sentences.hanzi: 优秀的城市规划师不仅关注建筑外形，更注重为社区居民营造富有人情味的公共活动空间。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yōuxiù de chéngshì guīhuàshī bùjǐn guānzhù jiànzhù wàixíng, gèng zhùzhòng wèi shèqū jūmín yíngzào fùyǒu rénqíngwèi de gōnggòng huódòng kōngjiān.
example_sentences.en: Talented urban planners focus not only on building aesthetics, but also on crafting public activity spaces rich in human warmth for residents.
example_sentences.es: Los urbanistas virtuosos no solo atienden a la volumetría exterior, sino a brindar a los vecinos espacios públicos acogedores para la convivencia.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Excavating an underground cave 穴 until an expansive, open empty cavity 空 emerges.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Digging open a rocky cave entrance (穴) to reveal a vast, airy open cavern (空).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Abrir la entrada de una caverna (穴) para descubrir una cámara despejada y vacía (空).

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Beams of sun (日) filtering brightly through the crevice between closed doors (门).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Rayos de sol (日) que se cuelan por el intersticio entre las hojas de la puerta (门).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国传统院落特别擅长在有限的占地内营造富有层次的空间体验。四合院通过游廊、垂花门与影壁的巧妙穿插，将原本规整的物理空间划分为庭院、起居与私密等不同领域，展现出静谧深沉的东方空间美学。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó chuántǒng yuànluò tèbié shàncháng zài yǒuxiàn de zhàndì nèi yíngzào fùyǒu céngcì de kōngjiān tǐyàn. Sìhéyuàn tōngguò yóuláng, chuíhuāmén yǔ yǐngbì de qiǎomiào chuānchā, jiāng yuánběn guīzhěng de wùlǐ kōngjiān huàfēn wéi tíngyuàn, qǐjū yǔ sìmì děng bùtóng lǐngyù, zhǎnxiàn chū jìngmì shēnchén de dōngfāng kōngjiān měixué.
extended_reading_passages.en: Traditional Chinese compounds excel at creating layered spatial experiences within limited footprints. Interlacing verandas, ornate gates, and screen walls partition physical space into garden, living, and private realms with quiet Eastern aesthetics.
extended_reading_passages.es: El patio tradicional chino descuella por articular ricas transiciones espaciales en solares acotados. Galerías, puertas caladas y cancelas modulan el espacio físico en zonas comunes, privadas y de jardín, expresando una sobria estética oriental.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 探索未知的外层空间，是人类追寻文明未来的宏伟征途。从最早的近地轨道卫星发射，到宇航员在国际空间站长期开展尖端科研，人类对深远空间的求索从未止步。浩瀚无垠的宇宙空间，激发着我们永恒的科学探索精神。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Tànsuǒ wèizhī de wàicéng kōngjiān, shì rénlèi zhuīxún wénmíng wèilái de hóngwěi zhēngtú. Cóng zuìzǎo de jìndì guǐdào wèixīng fāshè, dào yǔhángyuán zài guójì kōngjiānzhàn chángqī kāizhǎn jiānduān kēyán, rénlèi duì shēnyuǎn kōngjiān de qiúsuǒ cóng wèi zhǐbù. Hàohàn-wúyín de yǔzhòu kōngjiān, jīfā zhe wǒmen yǒnghéng de kēxué tànsuǒ jīngshén.
extended_reading_passages.en: Exploring unknown outer space represents humanity's grand quest for civilizational advancement. From early near-Earth satellites to long-duration stays aboard international space stations, cosmic space sparks our endless scientific spirit.
extended_reading_passages.es: La exploración del espacio exterior constituye la gran odisea de la civilización hacia el porvenir. Desde los satélites en órbita baja hasta las misiones en estaciones espaciales, el cosmos infinito aviva un afán inagotable de descubrimiento.

meanings_summary.es: plantar; cultivar; sembrar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Inserting a grain seedling (禾) into the heart of the ground (中) means to plant (种).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Enterrar un tallo de cereal (禾) en el centro fértil del surco (中) define el acto de sembrar (种).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Central to traditional Chinese agrarian civilization where planting seasonal crops regulated calendar rhythms and social customs.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Fourth tone as verb: 'zhòng' (51). Distinct from third-tone noun/classifier 'zhǒng' (kind/type). Pronounce with resolute downward pitch.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 种 (zhòng) functions as a transitive agricultural/horticultural verb meaning to embed seeds or saplings into earth.

contrasts.analysis: Fourth tone 种 (zhòng) is strictly verbal (to plant), whereas third tone 种 (zhǒng) is nominal/classifier (seed, kind, sort).
种 applies to flora and plants in earth, whereas 养 primarily targets animals (fish, birds) or ongoing personal care.
收 is the direct antonym meaning to harvest or reap what was previously planted.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Mouth radical 口 on the right instead of 中
Fire radical 火 on the right instead of 中
Little radical 少 on the right instead of 中

senses.definition_en: to put seeds, bulbs, or plants into the earth to grow; cultivate vegetation
senses.definition_es: sembrar simientes o plantar vegetales en la tierra para que crezcan; cultivar
senses.example_phrase: 在院子里种树 (plant trees in the courtyard)

example_sentences.hanzi: 北京人喜欢在四合院的中央天井里种上几株石榴树与海棠花，寓意着家族子孙兴旺、吉祥如意。
example_sentences.pinyin: Běijīng rén xǐhuan zài sìhéyuàn de zhōngyāng tiānjǐng lǐ zhòng shang jǐ zhū shíliushù yǔ hǎitánghuā, yùyì zhe jiāzú zǐsūn xīngwàng, jíxiáng-rúyì.
example_sentences.en: Beijingers love to plant pomegranates and crabapple trees in their courtyard centers, symbolizing thriving progeny and good fortune.
example_sentences.es: A los pequineses les complace plantar granados y begonias en el patio central del siheyuan, augurando descendencia floreciente y dicha.

example_sentences.hanzi: 退休后，王老师在郊区租下了一小块菜地，每天细心浇水除草，享受种菜的田园乐趣。
example_sentences.pinyin: Tuìxiū hòu, Wáng lǎoshī zài jiāoqū zū xià le yī xiǎo kuài càidì, měitiān xìxīn jiāoshuǐ chúcǎo, xiǎngshòu zhòng cài de tiányuán lèqù.
example_sentences.en: After retirement, Teacher Wang leased a small vegetable plot in the suburbs, watering and weeding daily to relish the idyllic fun of gardening.
example_sentences.es: Tras jubilarse, el profesor Wang arrendó una parcela en las afueras, dedicándose a regar y escardar para saborear la paz de cultivar hortalizas.

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 禾 (tender grain seedling) + 中 (penetrating soil stake)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Placing a grain seedling 禾 deep into the center 中 of fertile soil to take root; to cultivate.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Carefully planting a young cereal shoot (禾) into the heart (中) of tilled soil (种).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Hincar una espiga lozana (禾) en el seno (中) de la tierra labrada para que brote (种).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在老北京的四合院文化中，院落里的绿植栽种非常讲究。人们喜欢种石榴寓意“多子多福”，种海棠象征“富贵吉祥”，种紫藤增添春日雅趣。这些亲手栽种的花木，使院落一年四季都洋溢着勃勃生机。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài lǎo Běijīng de sìhéyuàn wénhuà zhōng, yuànluò lǐ de lǜzhí zāizhòng fēicháng jiǎngjiu. Rénmen xǐhuan zhòng shíliu yùyì 'duō zǐ duō fú', zhòng hǎitáng xiàngzhēng 'fùguì jíxiáng', zhòng zǐténg zēngtiān chūnrì yǎqù. Zhèxiē qīnshǒu zāizhòng de huāmù, shǐ yuànluò yī nián sìjì dōu yángyì zhe bóbó shēngjī.
extended_reading_passages.en: In the courtyard culture of old Beijing, planting greenery followed refined symbolism. Pomegranates meant fruitful posterity, crabapples heralded wealth, and wisteria lent spring elegance. These plants filled courtyards with vibrant vitality.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la tradición del siheyuan pekinés, plantar especies vegetales respondía a delicados simbolismos. El granado auguraba bendición familiar, la begonia prosperidad y la glicina distinción primaveral, infundiendo lozanía al hogar.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 春种一粒粟，秋收万颗子。大自然的农耕法则生动诠释了付出与回报的朴素道理。只有在春天辛勤播种、耐得住酷暑里的默默灌溉与耕耘，才能在金秋时节迎来稻谷飘香的丰收喜悦。种下的每一滴汗水，都将结出生命的实果。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chūn zhòng yī lì sù, qiū shōu wàn kē zǐ. Dàzìrán de nónggēng fǎzé shēngdòng quánshì le fùchū yǔ huíbào de pǔsù dàolǐ. Zhǐyǒu zài chūntiān xīnqín bōzhòng, nàidézhe kùshǔ lǐ de mòmò guàngài yǔ gēngyún, cái néng zài jīnqiū shíjié yínglái dàogǔ piāoxiāng de fēngshōu xǐyuè. Zhòng xià de měi yī dī hànshuǐ, dōu jiāng jiéchū shēngmìng de shíguǒ.
extended_reading_passages.en: Sow a single grain in spring, reap ten thousand seeds in autumn. Nature's agrarian law demonstrates the truth of effort and return. Only those who toil patiently in planting and irrigating will celebrate fragrant harvest joy in autumn.
extended_reading_passages.es: Sembrar un grano en primavera y cosechar miríadas en otoño ilustra la relación entre esfuerzo y fruto. Solo la constancia al sembrar y regar en estío permite gozar en otoño de la mies dorada; cada gota de sudor fructifica en vida.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The noble green bamboo stalks (竹) affixed with the everyday noun suffix (子) gives the word for bamboo (竹子).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Las varas estilizadas de bambú (竹) acompañadas del sufijo nominal (子) designan al bambú (竹子).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Revered as one of the 'Four Gentlemen' (梅兰竹菊) and 'Three Friends of Winter' (岁寒三友) for staying green through frost.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Second tone to neutral tone: 'zhú zi' (35-neutral). Rise crisply on 'zhú' and drop gently into a light, unstressed 'zi'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 竹子 refers specifically to the bamboo plant, its hollow canes, and cultural aesthetic connotations.

contrasts.analysis: 树木 designates woody broadleaf or coniferous trees with bark and solid trunks, unlike hollow-stemmed 竹子.
芦苇 refers to wetlands reeds, which lack the hard woody resilience and tall timber quality of 竹子.
竹笋 denotes the tender edible young shoots emerging from the soil, prior to maturing into adult 竹子.

senses.definition_en: a fast-growing woody perennial evergreen plant with hollow stems, revered in Chinese culture for upright resilience
senses.definition_es: planta perenne leñosa de tallos huecos y nudos marcados, venerada en la cultura china por su rectitud e integridad
senses.example_phrase: 一片翠绿的竹子 (a patch of emerald green bamboo)

example_sentences.hanzi: 主人在四合院的西南隅种了一丛挺拔的翠绿竹子，微风拂过时沙沙作响，别有一番诗情画意。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhǔrén zài sìhéyuàn de xīnányú zhòng le yī cóng tǐngbá de cuìlǜ zhúzi, wēifēng fúguò shí shāshā zuòxiǎng, bié yǒu yī fān shīqíng-huàyì.
example_sentences.en: The homeowner planted a cluster of emerald bamboos in the courtyard's southwest corner; when breezes stirred, they rustled poetically.
example_sentences.es: El dueño sembró matas de erguido bambú en un rincón del patio; con el roce de la brisa susurraban hojas, evocando viva poesía.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在中国传统文化中，坚韧不拔的竹子常常被文人雅士视为刚正高洁君子品格的生动象征。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó chuántǒng wénhuà zhōng, jiānrèn-bùbá de zhúzi chángcháng bèi wénrén yǎshì shìwéi gāngzhèng gāojié jūnzǐ pǐngé de shēngdòng xiàngzhēng.
example_sentences.en: In traditional Chinese culture, tenacious and upright bamboo is frequently hailed by scholars as an emblem of gentlemanly integrity.
example_sentences.es: En la tradición cultural china, el tenaz bambú ha sido ensalzado por letrados como símbolo de la rectitud e integridad del noble caballero.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: “宁可食无肉，不可居无竹。”北宋文豪苏东坡的名句道出了中国文人对竹子的偏爱。在老北京四合院中栽种几竿竹子，春发绿枝，冬经寒霜而不凋，使幽静的庭院平添了几分超尘脱俗的高雅风韵。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: 'Nìngkě shí wú ròu, bùkě jū wú zhú.' Běisòng wénháo Sū Dōngpō de míngjù dàochū le Zhōngguó wénrén duì zhúzi de piān'ài. Zài lǎo Běijīng sìhéyuàn zhōng zāizhòng jǐ gān zhúzi, chūn fā lǜzhī, dōng jīng hánshuāng ér bù diāo, shǐ yōujìng de tíngyuàn píngtiān le jǐ fēn chāochén-tuōsú de gāoyǎ fēngyùn.
extended_reading_passages.en: 'Better to dine without meat than live without bamboo.' Su Dongpo's famous line captured scholars' devotion. Planting bamboo in courtyards preserved evergreen grace through frost, lending tranquil compounds an ethereal elegance.
extended_reading_passages.es: 'Mejor comer sin carne que habitar sin bambú.' La célebre máxima de Su Dongpo encarna la devoción letrada. Unas cañas de bambú en el patio desafiaban la escarcha sin marchitarse, confiriendo al hogar un aire noble y desprendido.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 竹子不仅具有优美的观赏价值，在日常生活中更有极广的实用功能。从结实耐磨的竹席、轻巧坚固的竹椅，到文房四宝中的竹制毛笔筒，竹子以其坚韧与柔韧并存的独特物理特质，深深融入了中国百姓衣食住行的方方面面。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhúzi bùjǐn jùyǒu yōuměi de guānshǎng jiàzhí, zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng gèng yǒu jí guǎng de shíyòng gōngnéng. Cóng jiēshi-nàimó de zhúxí, qīngqiǎo jiāngù de zhúyǐ, dào wénfángsìbǎo zhōng de zhúzhì máobǐtǒng, zhúzi yǐ qí jiānrèn yǔ róurèn bìngcún de dútè wùlǐ tèzhì, shēnkè róngrù le Zhōngguó bǎixìng yī-shí-zhù-xíng de fāngfāng-miànmiàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Beyond ornamental grace, bamboo serves extensive practical utilities in daily life. From durable bamboo mats and light chairs to brush holders on writing desks, its balance of strength and flexibility touches every dimension of living.
extended_reading_passages.es: Más allá de su belleza paisajística, el bambú atesora múltiples utilidades prácticas. Desde esteras resistentes y sillas ligeras hasta portalápices de caligrafía, aúna flexibilidad y firmeza para integrarse en la vida diaria.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Carving standard dividing lines with a knife (刂) establishes clear criteria and contrasts (则).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Marcar deslindes normativos con la hoja del buril (刂) define el criterio legal y la contraposición (则).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Essential classical particle functioning as a pivotal turning marker in prose to balance paired contrasts and deductions.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Second tone: 'zé' (35). Lift the pitch swiftly with crisp tonal clarity.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 则 serves primarily in formal prose as a contrastive connective marker highlighting differing parallel behaviors.

contrasts.analysis: 但是 introduces a sharp spoken adversative turn ('but'), whereas 则 gently sets up parallel contrasts ('whereas/while').
却 highlights an outcome contrary to expectations, whereas 则 simply aligns two contrasting facts side by side.
而 links general coordination or transition, whereas 则 emphasizes categorical divergence between subjects.

Shelter radical 厂 around 则

senses.definition_en: used to indicate contrast between clauses (whereas / while), or conditional sequence (then)
senses.definition_es: empleado para marcar contraste entre proposiciones (en cambio, mientras que) o consecuencia lógica
senses.example_phrase: 东厢房住长子，西厢房则住次子 (eldest son in east wing, whereas second son in west wing)

example_sentences.hanzi: 在老北京四合院中，正房通常由家里的长辈居住，东西两侧的厢房则安排给晚辈读书生活。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài lǎo Běijīng sìhéyuàn zhōng, zhèngfáng tōngcháng yóu jiālǐ de zhǎngbèi jūzhù, dōngxī liǎngcè de xiāngfáng zé ānpái gěi wǎnbèi dúshū shēnghuó.
example_sentences.en: In old Beijing courtyards, the main room was usually occupied by family elders, whereas the side wings were allocated for juniors to study and live.
example_sentences.es: En el siheyuan pekinés, la estancia principal era para los mayores, mientras que las alas laterales se destinaban al estudio y descanso de los jóvenes.

example_sentences.hanzi: 遇到突发技术故障时，新手往往容易手忙脚乱，经验丰富的工程师则能沉着冷静地排查隐患。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yùdào tūfā jìshù gùzhàng shí, xīnshǒu wǎngwǎng róngyì shǒumáng-jiǎoluàn, jīngyàn fēngfù de gōngchéngshī zé néng chénzhuó-lěngjìng de páichá yǐnhuàn.
example_sentences.en: When confronting unexpected technical breakdowns, novices tend to panic, whereas seasoned engineers investigate hidden risks calmly.
example_sentences.es: Ante averías técnicas imprevistas, los novatos suelen perder la serenidad, mientras que los ingenieros curtidos localizan los fallos con calma.

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 贝 (bronze cauldron / cowrie currency) + 刂 (engraving knife)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Using a knife 刂 to carve binding statutory laws into bronze vessels 贝; signifies standard laws and conditional clauses.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Carving precise statutory regulations into a bronze vessel with a knife (刂) to establish standard rules (则).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Grabar ordenanzas con un buril (刂) sobre el bronce ceremonial para consagrar la ley (则).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国传统哲学强调阴阳互济。在四合院的建筑格局中，高大敞亮的正房属阳，处于主导地位；相对低矮的配房与厢房则属阴，处于辅佐地位。二者分工明确、刚柔并济，体现了和谐共生的古老宇宙观。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó chuántǒng zhéxué qiángdiào yīnyáng-hùjì. Zài sìhéyuàn de jiànzhù géjú zhōng, gāodà kuānchǎng de zhèngfáng shǔ yáng, chǔyú zhǔdǎo dìwèi; xiāngduì dī'ǎi de pèifáng yǔ xiāngfáng zé shǔ yīn, chǔyú fǔzuǒ dìwèi. Èrzhě fēngōng míngquè, gāngróu-bìngjì, tǐxiàn le héxié-gòngshēng de gǔlǎo yǔzhòuguān.
extended_reading_passages.en: Traditional Chinese philosophy stresses mutual complementarity between Yin and Yang. In courtyards, the spacious main room belongs to Yang in dominant standing, whereas lower wing-rooms belong to Yin in auxiliary role, balancing harmony.
extended_reading_passages.es: La filosofía tradicional china postula el equilibrio entre el yin y el yang. En el siheyuan, la amplia estancia principal representa la fuerza yang, mientras que las alas laterales encarnan la mesura yin, conjugando orden cósmico.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 面对瞬息万变的市场风云，盲目跟风的企业往往容易陷入危机，坚守核心原则与持续技术创新的企业则能化险为夷。审时度势、以变应变，则是优秀管理者带领团队在激烈的商业竞争中立于不败之地的制胜法宝。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Miànduì shùnxī-wànbiàn de shìchǎng fēngyún, mángmù gēnfēng de qǐyè wǎngwǎng róngyì xiànrù wēijī, jiānshǒu héxīn yuánzé yǔ chíxù jìshù chuàngxīn de qǐyè zé néng huàxiǎn-wéiyí. Shěnshí-duóshì, yǐ biàn yīng biàn, zé shì yōuxiù guǎnlǐzhě dàilǐng tuánduì zài jīliè de shāngyè jìngzhēng zhōng lìyú-bùbàizhīdì de zhìshèng fǎbǎo.
extended_reading_passages.en: Facing unpredictable market tides, enterprises following trends blindly fall into crises, whereas firms maintaining core principles and technical innovation turn perils into opportunities, mastering dynamic adaptability.
extended_reading_passages.es: Ante la volatilidad del mercado, las empresas que imitan a ciegas caen en crisis, mientras que las firmas fieles a sus principios e innovación superan la adversidad; adaptarse al cambio constituye la clave del éxito.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A shining golden-scaled (金) aquatic creature (鱼) is an ornamental goldfish (金鱼).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un pez (鱼) de brillantes escamas color oro (金) conforma el pez dorado (金鱼).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Bred in China since the Song Dynasty; '金鱼' puns with '金玉' (gold and jade), symbolizing wealth and good fortune in domestic compounds.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: First tone to second tone: 'jīn yú' (55-35). Clear elevated pitch on 'jīn', rising smoothly on 'yú'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 金鱼 specifically denotes domestic ornamental varieties of carp cultivated for vibrant color and decorative tanks.

contrasts.analysis: 鲤鱼 denotes common culinary carp, while 金鱼 are bred purely as ornamental pets in garden bowls.
热带鱼 refers to warm-water tropical species requiring heated tanks, whereas 金鱼 are temperate freshwater fish.
鲨鱼 denotes predatory marine sharks, entirely distinct from docile domestic 金鱼.

senses.definition_en: a small domesticated freshwater cyprinid fish, bred for brilliant colors and ornamental beauty in garden ponds and bowls
senses.definition_es: pequeño pez de agua dulce de vistosos colores y aletas ondulantes, criado con fines ornamentales en estanques y peceras
senses.example_phrase: 大鱼缸里养金鱼 (raise goldfish in a large fishbowl)

example_sentences.hanzi: 老北京四合院的庭院正中，常常摆放着一口青石大鱼缸，几尾红艳艳的金鱼在浮萍间悠然游动。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǎo Běijīng sìhéyuàn de tíngyuàn zhèngzhōng, chángcháng bǎifàng zhe yī kǒu qīngshí dà yúgāng, jǐ wěi hóngyànyàn de jīnyú zài fúpíng jiān yōurán yóudòng.
example_sentences.en: In the center of old Beijing courtyards, a large bluestone fish bowl often stood, where crimson goldfish glided leisurely among duckweed.
example_sentences.es: En medio del patio del siheyuan pekinés solía colocarse una pila de piedra donde varios peces dorados nadaban apacibles entre lentejas de agua.

example_sentences.hanzi: 公园人工湖畔聚集了许多儿童，兴高采烈地用小网兜捞着游来游去的小金鱼。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gōngyuán réngōnghúpàn jùjí le xǔduō értóng, xìnggāo-cǎiliè de yòng xiǎo wǎngdōu lāo zhe yóu lái yóu qù de xiǎo jīnyú.
example_sentences.en: Many children gathered by the park's artificial lake, joyfully scooping up swimming little goldfish with small dip nets.
example_sentences.es: Junto al estanque del parque se congregaban niños entusiasmados, atrapando con salabardos los pececillos dorados que surcaban el agua.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Precious nuggets of gleaming metal buried deep inside the subterranean earth 土; signifies gold.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Precious gold nuggets shining beneath the earthen surface (金).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Pepitas de oro refulgentes enterradas en las entrañas de la tierra (金).

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un pez estilizado con escamas y aleta caudal nadando en aguas cristalinas (鱼).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 老北京四合院有“天棚鱼缸石榴树，先生肥狗胖丫头”的俗谚，其中大鱼缸里养金鱼是不可或缺的闲趣。坐在葡萄架下，看着大瓷缸里金鱼摆动着飘逸如丝的尾鳍游来游去，生活平添了无限恬淡与宁静。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Lǎo Běijīng sìhéyuàn yǒu 'tiānpéng yúgāng shíliushù, xiānsheng féigǒu pàng yātou' de súyàn, qízhōng dà yúgāng lǐ yǎng jīnyú shì bùkě-huòquē de xiánqù. Zuò zài pútáojià xià, kàn zhe dà cígāng lǐ jīnyú bǎidòng zhe piāoyì rú sī de wěiqí yóu lái yóu qù, shēnghuó píngtiān le wúxiàn tiándàn yǔ níngjìng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Old Beijing folklore recalls courtyards with 'awnings, fish bowls, and pomegranates.' Keeping goldfish in stone basins was an indispensable pleasure; watching their silky fins flutter brought immense serenity to everyday life.
extended_reading_passages.es: Un viejo adagio pekinés evocaba los patios con 'toldos, estanques y granados'. Criar peces dorados en pilas de barro era un placer inexcusable: ver ondular sus sedosas colas bajo la parra impregnaba la vida de calma.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国金鱼的培育历史已有一千多年，被誉为“东方圣鱼”。古代养鱼名家通过代代精心选育，培育出了龙睛、水泡、狮子头等数百种体态优美、色彩斑斓的品种。这种将生命之美融入日常闲赏的艺术，生动展现了中华造物智慧。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó jīnyú de péiyù lìshǐ yǐ yǒu yīqiān duō nián, bèi yù wéi 'dōngfāng shèngyú'. Gǔdài yǎngyú míngjiā tōngguò dàidài jīngxīn xuǎnyù, péiyù chū le lóngjīng, shuǐpào, shīzitóu děng shùbǎi zhǒng tǐtài yōuměi, sècǎi bānlán de pǐnzhǒng. Zhè zhǒng jiāng shēngmìng zhī měi róngrù rìcháng xiánshǎng de yìshù, shēngdòng zhǎnxiàn le Zhōnghuá zàowù zhìhuì.
extended_reading_passages.en: China's breeding of goldfish spans over a millennium, earning them the title 'Sacred Fish of the Orient.' Master breeders developed hundreds of graceful varieties, integrating the beauty of nature into leisurely aesthetic contemplation.
extended_reading_passages.es: La cría del pez dorado en China supera el milenio, apodado 'pez sagrado de Oriente'. Selecciones milenarias dieron origen a variedades de insólita belleza, uniendo el arte de la contemplación y la maestría zootécnica tradicional.

meanings_summary.en: to create; produce; bring about; innovation
meanings_summary.es: crear; producir; engendrar; innovación

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Initiating a pioneering start (创) and fashioning it into reality (造) means to create (创造).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Fundar una novedad (创) y fabricarla con destreza (造) sintetiza el acto creador (创造).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Blends the conceptual inception of an idea (创) with the manual execution of building it (造), driving human civilization.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Double fourth tone: 'chuàng zào' (51-51). Articulate both syllables with energetic downward punch.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 创造 emphasizes bringing unprecedented new ideas, artworks, or social wealth into reality from scratch.

contrasts.analysis: 制造 focuses on routine industrial manufacturing along existing blueprints, whereas 创造 invents original concepts.
发现 reveals pre-existing things hitherto unnoticed (e.g. islands, laws), while 创造 constructs entirely novel things.
模仿 is the direct antonym meaning to copy or reproduce existing templates.

Hand radical 扌 on left of 仓
First radical 先 under 辶 instead of 告

senses.definition_en: to bring something entirely new into existence through intellect, labor, imagination, or skill
senses.definition_es: dar existencia a algo nuevo o inédito mediante el intelecto, trabajo, inventiva o destreza
senses.example_phrase: 创造美好生活 (create a wonderful life)

example_sentences.hanzi: 中国古代劳动人民凭借非凡的智慧，在四合院的规整天地中创造出了人与自然亲密交融的生活环境。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài láodòng rénmín píngjiè fēifán de zhìhuì, zài sìhéyuàn de guīzhěng tiāndì zhōng chuàngzào chū le rén yǔ zìrán qīnmì jiāoróng de shēnghuó huánjìng.
example_sentences.en: Relying on remarkable wisdom, ancient Chinese working people created a living environment where humanity and nature harmoniously blended inside quadrangles.
example_sentences.es: Con sabiduría admirable, el pueblo trabajador de la China clásica creó en el siheyuan un entorno residencial donde el hombre y la naturaleza se funden.

example_sentences.hanzi: 科研团队通过夜以继日的攻关试验，成功创造了一项具有国际自主知识产权的核心技术专利。
example_sentences.pinyin: Kēyán tuánduì tōngguò yèyǐjìrì de gōngguān shìyàn, chénggōng chuàngzào le yī xiàng jùyǒu guójì zìzhǔ zhīshichǎnquán de héxīn jìshù zhuānlì.
example_sentences.en: Through day-and-night testing breakthroughs, the research team successfully created a core technological patent with international proprietary rights.
example_sentences.es: A través de infatigables pruebas de laboratorio, el equipo científico creó con éxito una patente técnica primordial de titularidad propia.

idioms.meaning_en: superb craftsmanship excelling nature itself
pioneer something original and fresh
split open heaven and earth; epoch-making creation
display original and creative genius

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 仓 (storehouse / granary structure) + 刂 (cutting tool)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Carving new timber foundations with a blade 刂 to build a new grain storehouse 仓; to initiate or create.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Chiseling raw materials with a sharp knife (刂) to pioneer an innovative design (创).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Desbastar la madera con un cuchillo (刂) para fundar una obra nueva y singular (创).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 辶 (dynamic motion) + 告 (speech proclamation / bull horns)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Active physical motion 辶 executing an announced plan 告 to construct tangible works; to make or build.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Taking swift action on foot (辶) to build and fabricate an impressive artifact (造).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Emprender la marcha (辶) para confeccionar y levantar una edificación palpable (造).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国古代建筑工匠在四合院的营建中展现了惊人的创造才能。他们巧妙利用砖雕、木雕与彩绘艺术，在普通的房檐与门簪上创造出寓意深远的图案，把质朴的居住空间升华为富有诗意与人文温度的艺术殿堂。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài jiànzhù gōngjiàng zài sìhéyuàn de yíngjiàn zhōng zhǎnxiàn le jīngrén de chuàngzào cáinéng. Tāmen qiǎomiào lìyòng zhuāndiāo, mùdiāo yǔ cǎihuì yìshù, zài pǔtōng de fángyán yǔ ménzān shang chuàngzào chū yùyì shēnyuǎn de tú'àn, bǎ zhìpǔ de jūzhù kōngjiān shēnghuá wéi fùyǒu shīyì yǔ rénwén wēndù de yìshù diàntáng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Ancient artisans demonstrated astounding creative talent constructing courtyards. Ingeniously employing brick carvings and woodwork on eaves, they created profound motifs, sublimating living spaces into artistic halls steeped in poetic warmth.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los artesanos constructores de la China clásica hicieron gala de un pasmoso ingenio creador. Mediante tallas en ladrillo y madera, crearon motivos de hondo simbolismo en los aleros, transformando la vivienda en una joya artística de viva poesía.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 创新是推动人类文明进步的根本动力。当代青年应当敢于打破传统思维的陈旧藩篱，在科学技术与文化艺术的广阔天地中勇于创造。通过持续不断的探索与实践，我们才能为社会创造出更具价值的成果，让生活变得更加美好。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chuàngxīn shì tuīdòng rénlèi wénmíng jìnbù de gēnběn dònglì. Dāngdài qīngnián yīngdāng gǎnyú dǎpò chuántǒng sīwéi de chénjiù fānlí, zài kēxué jìshù yǔ wénhuà yìshù de guǎngkuò tiāndì zhōng yǒngyú chuàngzào. Tōngguò chíxù-bùduàn de tànsuǒ yǔ shíjiàn, wǒmen cái néng wèi shèhuì chuàngzào chū gèng jù jiàzhí de chéngguǒ, ràng shēnghuó biànde gèngjiā měihǎo.
extended_reading_passages.en: Innovation serves as the fundamental engine driving human progress. Modern youth must dare to shatter dogmas and create courageously across arts and sciences. Constant exploration generates higher value, enriching human existence.
extended_reading_passages.es: La innovación constituye el motor cardinal del avance humano. La juventud de hoy debe atreverse a derribar dogmas vetustos y crear con audacia en las artes y las ciencias. La experimentación continua crea valor perdurable para el bienestar común.

meanings_summary.en: emotional appeal; charm; aesthetic delight; taste; interest
meanings_summary.es: encanto; gusto estético; deleite; atractivo emocional

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Heartfelt sentiment (情) combined with captivating delight (趣) produces refined emotional charm (情趣).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El sentimiento hondo (情) enlazado al deleite lúdico (趣) engendra el encanto estético de la vida (情趣).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: A core concept of classical literati aesthetics valuing tea, calligraphy, zither, and gardening to transcend mundane chores.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Second tone to fourth tone: 'qíng qù' (35-51). Lift cleanly on 'qíng' and conclude with an expressive downward slope on 'qù'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 情趣 denotes aesthetic delight, tasteful hobbies, and poetic sensibility enriching everyday living.

contrasts.analysis: 兴趣 is curiosity or preference for a specific activity (sports, games), while 情趣 emphasizes poetic refinement and aesthetic charm.
趣味 leans toward playful fun or amusement, whereas 情趣 embodies deeper spiritual taste and romantic nuance.
乏味 is the direct antonym meaning dull, bland, and entirely devoid of delight.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Water radical 氵 on left instead of heart 忄
Sun radical 日 on left instead of heart 忄
Shield radical 干 beside 走 instead of 取

senses.definition_en: aesthetic charm, emotional interest, or refined taste that brings delight to everyday life
senses.definition_es: gracia, encanto estético o refinamiento afectivo que ameniza y eleva la vida cotidiana
senses.example_phrase: 富有生活情趣 (rich in life's charm and flavor)

example_sentences.hanzi: 老北京四合院中种花养鸟、摆石理水的生活方式，处处充满了悠闲高雅的东方生活情趣。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǎo Běijīng sìhéyuàn zhōng zhònghuā yǎngniǎo, bǎishí lǐshuǐ de shēnghuó fāngshì, chùchù chōngmǎn le yōuxián gāoyǎ de dōngfāng shēnghuó qíngqù.
example_sentences.en: The lifestyle of growing flowers, keeping pet birds, and arranging rockeries in courtyards brimmed with relaxed, refined Eastern life charm.
example_sentences.es: El modo de vida del siheyuan pekinés, cultivando flores, aves canoras y rocallas, rebosaba del distinguido encanto estético del sosiego oriental.

example_sentences.hanzi: 小李在书房里摆放了一盆苍劲的文竹与精致的紫砂茶具，使整个房间增添了浓郁的文雅情趣。
example_sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ zài shūfáng lǐ bǎifàng le yī pén cāngjìn de wénzhú yǔ jīngzhì de zǐshā chájù, shǐ zhěnggè fángjiān zēngtiān le nóngyù de wényǎ qíngqù.
example_sentences.en: Xiao Li arranged a vigorous asparagus fern and delicate clay tea set in his study, infusing the entire room with refined scholarly charm.
example_sentences.es: Xiao Li dispuso en su estudio un bonsái y un juego de té de gres fino, impregnando la estancia de un elegante gusto letrado.

rich in aesthetic charm and interest
possess a unique charm of its own

idioms.meaning_en: enjoyed by both refined scholars and the common folk alike
find contentment and delight in one's own hobbies
genuine feelings and heartfelt sincerity
brimming with rich flavor and engaging delight

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 忄 (heart feeling) + 青 (lush verdant youth / clarity)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Spontaneous feelings bubbling forth from the heart 忄 as fresh and pure as green shoots 青.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A heart (忄) blooming with fresh, verdant emotions like spring greenery (情).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un corazón (忄) que vibra con sentimientos limpios y lozanos como la primavera (情).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 走 (hasten toward) + 取 (grasp with hands / ear focus)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Hurrying eagerly on foot 走 to seize and enjoy 取 something captivating; denotes fun and charm.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Rushing forward enthusiastically (走) to grasp an engaging, delightful experience (趣).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Avanzar con paso ágil (走) para asir una experiencia amena y deleitable (趣).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国传统文人极其讲究起居生活的艺术情趣。在四合院的一隅，摆一盆苍翠菖蒲，焚一炉淡雅线香，邀二三知己在廊檐下品茗漫谈，不求富丽堂皇，但求恬淡自得。这种超凡脱俗的生活情趣，滋养着国人的心灵世界。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó chuántǒng wénrén jíqí jiǎngjiu qǐjū shēnghuó de yìshù qíngqù. Zài sìhéyuàn de yī yú, bǎi yī pén cāngcuì chāngpú, fén yī lú dànyǎ xiànxiāng, yāo èr sān zhījǐ zài lángyán xià pǐnmíng màntán, bù qiú fùlì-tánghuáng, dàn qiú tiándàn zìdé. Zhè zhǒng chāofán-tuōsú de shēnghuó qíngqù, zīyǎng zhe guórén de xīnlíng shìjiè.
extended_reading_passages.en: Traditional literati cultivated refined aesthetic taste in daily living. Tending calamus pots, burning incense, and sipping tea with confidants beneath verandas sought no luxury, but tranquil contentment that nurtured the soul.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los letrados tradicionales cultivaban con esmero el encanto estético en lo cotidiano. Colocar un cálamo verde, quemar incienso y saborear té con amigos bajo el alero no buscaba la opulencia, sino la serenidad interior que nutre el espíritu.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在快节奏的现代生活中，保持对日常琐事的细腻情趣尤为珍贵。在窗台上栽一束芬芳的鲜花，为家人亲手烹制一道精致的小点心，都能让平凡的日子重新焕发光彩。懂得品味生活情趣的人，总能在纷繁复杂的世界里发现美好的诗意。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài kuàijiézòu de xiàndài shēnghuó zhōng, bǎochí duì rìcháng suǒshì de xìnì qíngqù yóuwéi zhēnguì. Zài chuāngtái shang zāi yī shù fēnfāng de xiānhuā, wèi jiārén qīnshǒu pēngzhì yī dào jīngzhì de xiǎodiǎnxin, dōu néng ràng píngfán de rìzi chóngxīn huànfā guāngcǎi. Dǒngdé pǐnwèi shēnghuó qíngqù de rén, zǒng néng zài fēnfán-fùzá de shìjiè lǐ fāxiàn měihǎo de shīyì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Amid modern fast-paced living, preserving delicate charm toward everyday chores is precious. Flowers on windowsills and home-baked pastries illuminate routine days. Those with taste for life's charm always uncover poetic grace amidst chaos.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la vorágine actual, preservar el deleite estético por los pequeños detalles es un tesoro. Unas flores en la ventana o repostería casera devuelven el brillo a los días ordinarios; quien sabe saborear la vida halla poesía dondequiera que mire.

meanings_summary.en: therefore; as a result; thus; consequently
meanings_summary.es: por lo tanto; en consecuencia; por ende; de ahí que

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Taking a cause (因) and carrying it forward (而) yields the conclusive result (因而).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Tomar la causa originaria (因) y proseguir el curso lógico (而) arroja el desenlace natural (因而).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: A formal coordinating consecutive conjunction in written Chinese that seamlessly ties prerequisite conditions to inevitable outcomes.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: First tone to second tone: 'yīn ér' (55-35). Start with a level high pitch on 'yīn', then rise smoothly on 'ér'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 因而 explicitly marks an inevitable outcome or natural consequence resulting from the preceding premise.

contrasts.analysis: 因为 introduces the causal antecedent ('because'), whereas 因而 introduces the resulting consequence ('consequently').
因此 is broader and common in spoken register, while 因而 highlights the causal chain's natural progression.
反而 indicates an outcome contrary to expectations, whereas 因而 confirms expected logical consequences.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Cross inside 囗 instead of 大
Eight 八 inside 囗 instead of 大
Contains 自/目 frame at the top
Woman radical 女 under 而

senses.definition_en: connects two clauses to indicate that the latter is the natural consequence, result, or deduction from the former
senses.definition_es: conector lógico que enlaza dos proposiciones indicando que la segunda es consecuencia directa de la primera
senses.example_phrase: 因而不受干扰 (consequently free from disturbance)

example_sentences.hanzi: 四合院的四面建筑紧密围合，隔绝了外界街巷的喧嚣，因而能够为院内居民营造出安宁静谧的生活氛围。
example_sentences.pinyin: Sìhéyuàn de sìmiàn jiànzhù jǐnmì wéihé, géjué le wàijiè jiēxiàng de xuānxīao, yīn'ér nénggòu wèi yuànnèi jūmín yíngzào chū ānníng jìngmì de shēnghuó fēnwéi.
example_sentences.en: The quadrangle's four-sided structures tightly enclose the space, sealing off exterior alley clamor; as a result, it fosters an ambiance of serene quiet.
example_sentences.es: Los edificios del siheyuan cierran el recinto aislando el estruendo de los callejones, por lo que brindan a los vecinos un sosiego reconfortante.

example_sentences.hanzi: 实验室采用了最先进的高精度自动化仪器，因而大幅度提升了日常科研数据的采集效率与准确度。
example_sentences.pinyin: Shíyànshì cǎiyòng le zuì xiānjìn de gāojīngdù zìdònghuà yíqì, yīn'ér dàfúdù tíshēng le rìcháng kēyán shùjù de cǎijí xiàolǜ yǔ zhǔnquèdù.
example_sentences.en: The laboratory adopted state-of-the-art high-precision automated instruments; consequently, data acquisition efficiency and precision soared.
example_sentences.es: El laboratorio incorporó instrumentación automatizada de alta precisión, mejorando sustancialmente la rapidez y exactitud en la recolección de datos.

follow logically and smoothly; natural course of events
guide action along existing momentum
prevent troubles before they happen

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 囗 (enclosure) + 大 (person resting on mat)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A person 大 resting securely upon an enclosed sleeping mat 囗; represents the ground, basis, or cause.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A person (大) reclining on a woven resting mat (囗) as the basis and reason for rest (因).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una persona (大) descansando sobre una estera (囗), fundamento y causa de su reposo (因).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: pictograph of flowing facial whiskers or chin beard
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Flowing facial whiskers hanging downward; serves as a universal connective marker in speech.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Flowing wisps of a sage's beard (而) smoothly connecting thoughts together.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Los mechones de la barba de un sabio (而) que enlazan con fluidez ideas sucesivas.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 老北京四合院的建筑格局严格遵照坐北朝南的朝向，正房因而能够在一整年里获取最充沛的日照与良好的自然通风。夏季南风徐来，冬季北风受阻，因而形成了一个极为适宜日常安居的健康微气候。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Lǎo Běijīng sìhéyuàn de jiànzhù guīzhì yángé zūnzhào zuòběi-cháonán de cháoxiàng, zhèngfáng yīn'ér nénggòu zài yī zhěng nián lǐ huòqǔ zuì chōngpèi de rìzhào yǔ liánghǎo de zìrán tōngfēng. Xiàjì nánfēng xú lái, dōngjì běifēng shòuzǔ, yīn'ér xíngchéng le yī gè jíwéi shìyí rìcháng ānjū de jiànkāng wēiqìhòu.
extended_reading_passages.en: Beijing quadrangles strictly face south; as a result, the main room obtains optimal daylight and natural ventilation year-round. Summer breezes enter while winter gales are blocked; consequently, a healthy microclimate is forged.
extended_reading_passages.es: El siheyuan pekinés se orienta estrictamente al sur; de ahí que su sala principal disfrute de luz y ventilación óptimas todo el año. En verano entran brisas y en invierno se frena el cierzo, forjando un microclima ideal.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 科研团队在关键算法的设计中始终贯彻轻量化理念，代码执行效率因而提升了数倍，能源消耗因而显著降低。这项突破不仅赢得了国际同行的广泛赞誉，更因而为公司在激烈的海外市场竞争中赢得了宝贵的先机。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Kēyán tuánduì zài guānjiàn suànfǎ de shèjì zhōng shǐzhōng guàngchè qīngliànghuà lǐniàn, dàimǎ zhíxíng xiàolǜ yīn'ér tíshēng le shù bèi, néngyuán xiāohào yīn'ér xiǎnzhù jiàngdī. Zhè xiàng tūpò bùjǐn yíngdé le guójì tóngháng de guǎngfàn zànyù, gèng yīn'ér wèi gōngsī zài jīliè de hǎiwài shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng yíngdé le bǎoguì de xiānjī.
extended_reading_passages.en: The research team pursued lightweight design in its algorithms; consequently, execution efficiency surged and power consumption dropped. This breakthrough not only won international praise, but thus secured an advantage in markets.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A hand guiding action to serve as an agent or cause (为) marks passive agency (为……所……).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Una mano guiando la acción para fungir de agente o causa (为) articula la voz pasiva (为……所……).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Versatile grammatical particle originating in Bronze script meaning 'to manage or act', central to classical passives and transformations.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Second tone: 'wéi' (35). Distinct from fourth tone preposition 'wèi' (for the sake of). Rise smoothly.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 为 (wéi, second tone) functions in formal registers as a passive marker (被/为……所) or copular verb meaning 'to serve as/become'.

contrasts.analysis: Second-tone 为 (wéi) denotes passivity or acting as, whereas fourth-tone 为 (wèi) marks benefactive purpose ('for the sake of').
被 is the colloquial modern passive preposition, while 为……所 is an elevated literary passive structure.
当 focuses on serving in a concrete professional post (当老师), while 为 covers broader functional roles (选为代表).

example_sentences.hanzi: 四合院这种凝聚了东方哲学智慧的传统建筑形式，历经沧桑变迁，至今仍为中外建筑学者所赞叹。
example_sentences.pinyin: Sìhéyuàn zhè zhǒng níngjù le dōngfāng zhéxué zhìhuì de chuántǒng jiànzhù xíngshì, lìjīng cāngsāng biànqiān, zhìjīn réng wéi zhōngwài jiànzhù xuézhě suǒ zàntàn.
example_sentences.en: As a traditional architecture embodying Eastern philosophical wisdom, courtyards withstand shifting eras and are praised by scholars worldwide.
example_sentences.es: El siheyuan, síntesis de la sabiduría filosófica oriental, pervive tras siglos de vicisitudes y sigue siendo elogiado por arquitectos del mundo entero.

example_sentences.hanzi: 他不仅在学术界享有崇高威望，更被同行们一致推选为本届国际地质学会理事长。
example_sentences.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn zài xuéshùjiè xiǎngyǒu chónggāo wēiwàng, gèng bèi tóngháng men yīzhì tuīxuǎn wéi běnjiè guójì dìzhì xuéhuì lǐshìzhǎng.
example_sentences.en: Not only does he enjoy lofty prestige in academia, but he was also unanimously elected by peers to serve as president of the Geological Society.
example_sentences.es: No solo goza de sólido prestigio académico, sino que fue elegido por sus colegas para actuar como presidente de la Sociedad Geológica Internacional.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国传统四合院建筑的严整规制与深厚文化底蕴，不仅深受国人自豪珍视，更广为世界建筑界所瞩目。许多外国学者不远万里来到北京胡同，实地考察四合院的梁架雕饰，皆为其巧夺天工的匠心所折服。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó chuántǒng sìhéyuàn jiànzhù de yánzhěng guīzhì yǔ shēnhòu wénhuà dǐyùn, bùjǐn shēn shòu guórén zìháo zhēnshì, gèng guǎng wéi shìjiè jiànzhùjiè suǒ zhǔmù. Xǔduō wàiguó xuézhě bùyuǎn-wànlǐ lái dào Běijīng hútòng, shídì kǎochá sìhéyuàn de liángjià diāoshì, jiē wéi qí qiǎoduó-tiāngōng de jiàngxīn suǒ zhéfú.
extended_reading_passages.en: The rigorous structure and profound culture of Chinese courtyards are cherished domestically and noticed by the global architectural community. Foreign scholars travel to Beijing alleys, consistently captivated by the ingenious craftsmanship.
extended_reading_passages.es: La armoniosa traza y hondo bagaje cultural del siheyuan son orgullo nacional y despiertan admiración internacional. Eruditos de todo el mundo viajan a los hutongs de Pekín, rindiéndose ante su primorosa maestría artesanal.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在漫长的历史长河中，优秀的中华传统美德世代相传，化为民族精神的血脉源泉。历代仁人志士以天下兴亡为己任，百折不挠，他们崇高的人格风范永远为后人所景仰与缅怀，激励着一代代青年奋发图强。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài màncháng de lìshǐ chánghé zhōng, yōuxiù de Zhōnghuá chuántǒng měidé shìdài xiāngchuán, huà wéi mínzú jīngshén de xuèmài yuánquán. Lìdài rénrén-zhìshì yǐ tiānxià xīngwáng wéi jǐ rèn, bǎizhé-bùnáo, tāmen chónggāo de réngé fēngfàn yǒngyuǎn wéi hòurén suǒ jǐngyǎng yǔ miǎnhuái, jīlì zhe yīdàidài qīngnián fènfā-túqiáng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Across Chinese history, traditional virtues passed down to become the lifeblood of national spirit. Patriots shouldered responsibility for the common good; their integrity is revered by posterity, inspiring generations to strive.
extended_reading_passages.es: A lo largo de la historia, las virtudes clásicas se transmitieron como savia del espíritu patrio. Ilustres próceres asumieron el destino común; su entereza moral sigue siendo venerada por las generaciones venideras.
